Reports to:Sr. Director of Growth

Status: Full-Time/ W2/Individual Contributor

Location:Remote US-based / limited travel may be required

Do you thrive in a role that dives deep into hands-on Amazon execution while steering high-level channel strategy?

Have you successfully scaled 7- or 8-figure Amazon Seller Central accounts in the dietary supplement space while navigating strict FDA/FTC compliance?

Are you an Amazon SME who excels at managing agencies, mastering PPC/SEO, and taking total ownership of account profitability in a fast-paced, remote environment?

If you answered yes to these questions, we want to talk to you.

Position Overview

We are a high-growth, mid-sized dietary supplement brand seeking a hungry, operator-first Amazon Marketplace Manager to assume end-to-end commercial ownership, operational execution, and net profitability of our Amazon Seller Central (3P) account. Balancing hands-on execution with high-level channel strategy (roughly 70/30), you will serve as our internal Subject Matter Expert (SME), offloading daily operations from senior leadership to drive revenue in a fast-paced, remote environment. In this role, you will own keyword ranking and Amazon SEO, manage PPC campaigns, optimize listing efficiency, strictly enforce dietary supplement regulatory compliance, and direct our external agency partner to maximize output.

Who is Organics Ocean

Organics Ocean is a premium DTC supplement brand empowering health through science-backed, clean, and effective products. We are building a trusted wellness authority rooted in transparency, education, and long-term customer loyalty.

Our Culture

We operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where we constantly test, optimize, and innovate. Our team consists of high-performing operators who move with urgency and take pride in their craft. We maintain a collaborative, low-ego culture where feedback is direct, expectations are clear, and strong ideas win regardless of title. We believe our next stage of expansion requires A-players who thrive in ambiguity and hold a high bar for excellence.

To learn the founder’s story and more about Organics Ocean, visit ourwebsite and review ourCultural Pillars.

Why Join Our Team?

  • Rapid Expansion: Join an innovative eCommerce leader experiencing 350% year-over-year growth.
  • True Ownership: We trust our team to lead and execute without micromanagement. We value individuals who take initiative and drive meaningful results.
  • Elite Performance: Work alongside driven professionals in an environment built for continuous improvement and professional evolution.

What You’ll Own

Commercial Ownership & Agency Direction

  • Channel Performance: Lead day-to-day operations across Amazon Seller Central (FBA/FBM), driving top-line growth while optimizing net profitability, unit economics, TACoS, and MER.
  • Agency Oversight: Serve as the primary internal manager for our external Amazon agency. Audit their performance, set strategic direction, and leverage them as an execution resource (e.g., ticket resolution, customer service, case escalations).
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with design leads on creative assets, collaborate with the DTC team to align Shopify and Amazon strategies, and deliver clear performance visibility to leadership.

Keyword Strategy, SEO & Listing Optimization

  • SEO & Keyword SME: Conduct ongoing keyword research, competitor analysis, and index tracking. Execute strategic listing updates to capture high-volume/high-intent search terms and gain category market share.
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Execute continuous A/B testing on titles, main images, infographics, bullet points, and Storefront layouts to maximize CTR and CVR.
  • A+ Content & Brand Story: Direct the strategy and layout overhaul for A+ Content, Premium A+, and the Amazon Brand Story.

Advertising & Data Analytics

  • Full-Funnel Ad Strategy: Oversee and optimize PPC campaigns (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display) and leverage DSP/AMC strategies to capture search volume and scale market share.
  • Deep Analytics Reporting: Analyze catalog performance using native tools (Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, Search Term Reports) to evaluate search volume capture versus brand share.
  • Cross-Channel Measurement: Track SKU-level contribution margins, TACoS vs. ACoS targets, and the halo effect of DTC ad spend on Amazon search lift using analytics platforms (e.g., Triple Whale, Google Sheets).

Account Health, Compliance & Operations

  • Dietary Supplement Compliance: Enforce strict adherence to FDA guidelines, FTC structure/function claim rules, and Amazon supplement policies across all copy, images, and A+ Content.
  • Account Defense: Continuously monitor Seller Central health, Voice of the Customer (VoC) metrics, and listing statuses to quickly resolve suppressed listings, stranded inventory, and policy flags.
  • Customer Retention & Inventory: Manage Subscribe & Save performance, review acquisition strategies (including Amazon Vine), and collaborate with logistics on FBA stock forecasting.

First 3 Immediate Projects:

  1. Listing SEO & Keyword Audit: Perform an end-to-end audit and keyword optimization across all active listings.
  2. Ad Portfolio Realignment: Reallocate advertising spend across the product catalog based on keyword audit insights.
  3. Content Overhaul Strategy: Develop the roadmap to upgrade A+ Content, Premium A+, and Brand Story assets.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days:

  • Fully assume strategic direction and operational oversight of the agency relationship.
  • Capture measurable new keyword ownership and top-of-search rankings.
  • Achieve an improved distribution and efficiency of ad spend across the catalog.

In 12 Months:

  • Drive organic rank improvements for core revenue-generating SKUs.
  • Efficiently scale advertising spend to support the brand’s path toward $46M in annual revenue.

What You Bring | Must-Haves

  • 5+ Years of Amazon Seller Central (3P) Experience: Proven track record of managing end-to-end operations and driving 7- or 8-figure annual revenue growth.
  • Leadership Experience: Minimum of 2 years directly managing a team, with demonstrated experience in continuous performance coaching, team development, employee discipline, and conducting annual performance reviews.
  • Dietary Supplement / CPG Expertise: Direct experience in dietary supplements, nutraceuticals, or consumables, with a clear understanding of FDA/FTC claim compliance and category gating.
  • Agency Management: Proven background directing external agencies, auditing performance metrics, and guiding tactical execution.
  • Ad Platform Mastery: Hands-on experience with Amazon PPC (Sponsored Ads) and familiarity with native tools (Amazon DSP, Amazon Attribution, Amazon Marketing Cloud).
  • SEO, Visual & Analytics Tool Proficiency: Experience optimizing brand content for both desktop and mobile user experiences, alongside proficiency in Amazon SEO tools (e.g., Helium 10, Jungle Scout) and native reporting (Search Query Performance, Brand Analytics).
  • Financial Acumen: Strong proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel for analyzing TACoS vs. ACoS, contribution margins, and SKU-level unit economics.
  • Ability to accommodate limited required travel
  • Willingness to work US time zones, regardless of geographic location.
  • Access to a computer, a reliable internet connection, and a distraction-free work environment

Ideal Candidate

  • Operator Mindset: Heavily execution-focused (70% operator / 30% strategist) with a scrappy, self-motivated work style.
  • Remote Autonomy: Comfortable operating independently using ClickUp, Slack, Dropbox, and Google Workspace.
  • Problem Solver: Calm and systematic when navigating platform updates, stranded inventory, or Seller Support escalations.

Offer Details

  • Pay: $115,000 – $175,000. Final base salary within this range will be determined based on multiple factors, including candidate location, relevant skills, depth of experience, scope of responsibilities, applicable licenses or credentials, and internal equity.
  • Time Off: 15 days of PTO + 10 paid U.S. holidays per year
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive healthcare, dental, and vision plans
  • Financial Growth: 401(k) with a best-in-class company match
  • Perks: Exclusive employee product discounts

Software Utilized by the Company

ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace, Dropbox, Triple Whale, Aspire, Canva, Everflow, Figma, Google Meet, A2X, QuickBooks

Our Interview Process

Our selection process involves an Application review, HR Interview, and Hiring Manager Interview. Depending on the role, candidates may also complete a Paid Project and a final interview with our Director, VP, or CEO. Because we take great care in selecting our team, our hiring timeline may adjust based on business needs to ensure the best long-term fit.

raw.excerpt: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
raw.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍UK Remote | 💰£68,400 to £89,575 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

⭐️ Our Ops Labs Team

We’re building Ops Labs: a small, high-impact team focused on incubating, testing and scaling new ideas that improve customer experience and create enterprise value for Monzo.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, data and experimentation. You’ll take ideas from concept to reality - rapidly testing hypotheses, learning what works (and what doesn’t), and turning the best ideas into scalable solutions across Operations.

Many of these ideas will come from our strategy work, customer insight, and experience gaps. Your job is to turn them into tangible experiments, validate their impact, and help scale the ones that meaningfully improve customer outcomes, reduce cost, or unlock new value.

This is a zero-to-one role. You’ll need to be comfortable operating with high ambiguity, building structure where none exists, and working hands-on to bring ideas to life.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

  • Turning ideas into real-world experiments - Take ideas emerging from strategy, customer insights, and experience gaps, and translate them into testable hypotheses. Design and execute experiments end-to-end — from scoping and setup to execution, measurement and readout — with a strong bias to action and speed.
  • Incubating high-potential opportunities - Identify and develop early-stage ideas that could significantly improve customer experience, reduce operational demand, or create commercial value. This could include rethinking service models, testing new ways to deliver support, or exploring entirely new capabilities within Ops.
  • Scaling successful experiments into production - Work closely with product, engineering, data science and operations teams to take successful pilots and scale them. Ensure there is a clear path from experiment → validated impact → operational or product integration.
  • Advancing goodwill and customer experience innovation - Reimagine how we deliver goodwill and recover from poor experiences — testing new approaches that improve customer trust while being sustainable and scalable. Push beyond incremental fixes to meaningfully raise the bar for customer experience.
  • Creating strong feedback loops with data science and CX insights - Partner closely with Customer Experience, Data Science and Insights teams to ensure experiments are informed by real customer pain points, and that we rigorously track the impact of changes (e.g. what actually improves CSAT, reduces complaints, or drives engagement).
  • Measuring impact and building the case for change - Define clear success metrics for experiments (CSAT, demand reduction, cost, engagement, etc.), track outcomes, and communicate results clearly. Build compelling cases to scale, iterate, or stop initiatives based on evidence.
  • Working hands-on with frontline operations (COps) - Collaborate closely with COps to test ideas in real environments. Use their feedback and expertise to refine experiments and ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and grounded in reality.
  • Pave the way for building a bigger experimentation engine - Depending on how successful the experiments are, scale the team to make the remit bigger and accelerate commercial opportunities.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have experience in strategy, product, operations, or a similar role, with a track record of taking ideas from concept to execution
  • You are highly comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy building from zero to one
  • You have strong problem-solving skills and can structure and break down complex, unclear problems
  • You have a bias to action and are comfortable testing ideas quickly rather than over-optimising upfront
  • You are analytical and able to define success metrics, interpret results, and make data-informed decisions
  • You are a strong communicator, able to clearly articulate ideas, experiments, and outcomes to different audiences
  • You are collaborative and can work effectively across functions (Ops, Product, Data, Engineering)
  • You are pragmatic and outcome-focused, balancing speed with quality and impact
  • You are curious about customer experience and motivated to improve it in meaningful ways

The following would be a bonus:

    • Experience running experiments (A/B testing, pilots, operational trials, etc.)
    • Experience working on zero-to-one products, services, or initiatives
    • Experience in operations, customer support, or service design
    • Experience working closely with data science or analytics teams
    • Experience in a high-growth or fast-changing environment.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

  • Application questions - We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here
  • Recruiter Call - 30 mins
  • 1st stage Technical Interview - 1 hour
  • and if you pass the 1st stage, a 2nd stage interview with case study.

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £68,400 to £89,575 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

⏰ This role requires you to work 40 hours a week, Monday - Friday between core hours 8am - 6pm.

📍This role is within the UK - we cannot sponsor Visas for this role

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we'll always work around your availability. You'll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process, but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact

This role will close when we feel we have received enough suitable applications, so please apply early.

Good luck 🍀

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

Hobbs Madison is a leading consulting firm dedicated to bridging the gap between business strategy and technology execution. We combine deep technical and management expertise to solve complex challenges, enhance capabilities, and drive competitive growth. Our clients include some of the largest banking, insurance and investment firms in the United States.

We are seeking a VP, Account Executive with proven sales expertise in the Consumer and Commercial Banking sectors. This individual will be responsible for driving new client acquisition and expanding relationships with existing accounts, focusing on banking executives, institutional decision makers, and technology leaders. By combining consultative selling skills, deep industry knowledge, and an entrepreneurial approach, the Account Executive will identify opportunities, build trusted relationships, and deliver tailored solutions that address client needs across banking technology, operations, and services.

The ideal candidate will have experience managing complex sales cycles with C-Suite executives and senior stakeholders in financial institutions, including both short-term opportunities and multi-year engagements. They will excel at uncovering business challenges, positioning high-value consulting and technology solutions, and ensuring client satisfaction through ongoing engagement and partnership.

This is a full-time, remote role with occasional travel required for client meetings, industry events, and relationship development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to drive new business and grow existing client accounts within the consumer and commercial banking sector.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with C-Suite executives, senior decision makers, and institutional leaders to understand their challenges and position high-value solutions.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, lead qualification, proposal development, negotiation, and contract closure.
  • Collaborate with internal consulting and delivery teams to align solutions with client requirements and ensure seamless handoff from sales to execution.
  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities to expand client relationships beyond initial engagements.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitive offerings to position Hobbs Madison as a trusted partner.
  • Represent the company at client meetings, conferences, and industry events to strengthen brand presence and expand networks.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline management, and client interaction records using CRM tools.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by engaging regularly to uncover evolving needs and position new opportunities.
About You
  • 7+ years of technical consultative sales experience within the Consumer and/or Commercial Banking, Investment Firms, or Financial Services industry.
  • Deep understanding of banking operations, digital transformation initiatives, and technology-driven solutions.
  • Strong experience working with C-Suite executives and senior decision makers in financial institutions.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets and successfully managing both short and long sales cycles.
  • Ability to balance strategic planning with tactical execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify, pursue, and close new business opportunities.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Exceptional work ethic, positive attitude, strong integrity, and drive to succeed
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for client meetings and events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or related field required; MBA a plus.

Our History

Founded in 2002, Hobbs Madison Inc. is a consulting firm specializing in technology and business solutions for the financial services industry. We partner with leading banks, insurance companies, and investor services firms to maximize existing platforms, implement innovative solutions, and deliver results quickly.

Our senior consultants average 15+ years of industry and technology experience, combining technical expertise, business insight, and clear communication to solve complex challenges. Known for our speed, precision, and collaborative approach, we help clients navigate change, improve capabilities, and strengthen their competitive edge.

Hobbs Madison has established a reputation among its clients as one of the leading Strategy and IT Consultants in the U.S. for the financial services industry.

Performance Marketing Specialist – Google Ads, Meta Ads & Paid Media | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Preferred Locations: Pakistan, LATAM, South Africa, Philippines

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Performance Marketing Specialist to manage, optimize, and scale paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other digital channels.

This is a hands-on paid media role focused on measurable growth and acquisition performance — not simply campaign coordination.

You’ll own campaign execution, budget optimization, conversion tracking, A/B testing, attribution, and performance reporting, with a focus on improving ROAS, CPA, CPL, and conversion rates.

You’ll collaborate with creative, content, sales, and marketing teams to turn advertising spend into qualified leads, customers, and revenue.

If you’re a data-driven marketer who enjoys testing, optimizing, and scaling campaigns, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Paid Media Campaign Management

  • Build, launch, and manage campaigns across:
    • Google Ads
    • Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
    • LinkedIn Ads
    • Other relevant paid channels
  • Manage campaigns focused on lead generation, customer acquisition, sales, revenue, and brand growth
  • Develop and test audiences, messaging, creatives, and campaign structures
  • Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, targeting, and placements
  • Scale winning campaigns while maintaining performance efficiency

Campaign Optimization & Growth

  • Monitor campaign performance and optimize accounts regularly
  • Improve key metrics including:
    • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
    • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
    • Cost Per Lead (CPL)
    • Click-Through Rate (CTR)
    • Conversion Rate
  • Identify underperforming campaigns and implement improvements
  • Test new channels, audiences, formats, and acquisition strategies
  • Scale successful campaigns based on performance data

A/B Testing & Experimentation

  • Develop and execute structured tests across:
    • Ad creatives
    • Copy and messaging
    • Audiences
    • Landing pages
    • Offers
    • Bidding strategies
  • Analyze test results and identify winning variations
  • Use campaign learnings to continuously improve acquisition performance

Analytics, Attribution & Conversion Tracking

  • Track campaign performance using:
    • Google Analytics
    • Google Tag Manager
    • Advertising platform dashboards
  • Monitor CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, and conversion rates
  • Maintain accurate conversion tracking and attribution
  • Analyze funnel performance from ad click through conversion
  • Troubleshoot tracking issues and data inconsistencies
  • Identify performance trends and growth opportunities through campaign data

Funnel & Conversion Optimization

  • Understand the full customer acquisition journey from impression to conversion

Creative & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Requirements

  • Experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and advertising platform analytics
  • Demonstrated ability to:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Nice to Have

Tools & Platforms

Google Ads | Meta Ads | LinkedIn Ads | Google Analytics | Google Tag Manager | HubSpot | Salesforce | Marketo | CRM & Marketing Automation Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You might start by reviewing campaign dashboards, spend, conversions, CPA, CPL, and ROAS across active accounts.

Throughout the day, you may collaborate with creative teams on new ad concepts, review landing-page performance, troubleshoot tracking issues, and analyze lead or revenue quality with sales and marketing teams.

raw.description:
Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

At Personify Health, we value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe in creating teams made up of individuals with various backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Why? Because diversity inspires innovation, collaboration, and challenges us to produce better solutions. But more than this, diversity is our strength, and a catalyst in our ability to create a personalized experience for our clients and members. Because #healthispersonal.

Responsibilities

What You'll Actually Do

Who are you?

As a Product Marketing Manager for the Wellbeing business at Personify Health, you will help define how our wellbeing solutions show up in market, connect to buyer needs, and enable revenue teams to communicate differentiated value with confidence. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Enablement, Sales, SAE, Account Management, CBR, and other cross-functional teams, translating product capabilities, market insights, and customer needs into clear positioning, compelling messaging, practical go-to-market plans, and high-impact commercial content.

You will be responsible for understanding the Wellbeing portfolio, priority audiences, competitive landscape, sales motions, buyer challenges, and product roadmap. You will craft benefits-led narratives, launch plans, enablement assets, buyer-facing content, and internal readiness materials that help teams bring the right message to the right audience at the right moment. Your work will support acquisition, retention, expansion, adoption, and stronger commercial execution across the Wellbeing business.

You are a strategic, hands-on product marketer who can simplify complexity, influence across teams, and move work from insight to execution. You are comfortable partnering closely with Product to understand roadmap direction, with Enablement to activate GTM motions, and with Sales, SAE, Account Management, and other commercial teams to ensure messaging, assets, and training are useful, current, and aligned to real customer conversations. You bring strong storytelling, business judgment, project ownership, and a bias for measurable impact.

In this role, your work will be essential in the following areas:

Many of these responsibilities will be delivered in partnership with cross-functional teams and aligned to business priorities, product roadmap needs, and defined areas of specialization.

  • Market, Buyer, and Competitive Expertise – Build and maintain a deep understanding of the Wellbeing market, priority segments, buyer personas, influencers, customer needs, industry trends, sales motions, and competitive dynamics. Regularly synthesize win/loss insights, sales conversations, customer feedback, analyst or market inputs, and competitive intelligence to inform positioning, enablement, GTM strategy, and roadmap feedback.
  • Positioning and Messaging – Develop and maintain clear, differentiated, benefits-led positioning, messaging, value propositions, proof points, and buyer narratives for the Wellbeing portfolio. Ensure messaging reflects Personify Health’s unique value, resonates across buyer and influencer audiences, and can be consistently activated across campaigns, sales conversations, proposals, events, executive presentations, and client-facing materials.
  • Go-to-Market Strategy and Launch Readiness – Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Enablement, Sales, SAE, Account Management, CBR, and other teams to plan, coordinate, and execute GTM motions for new solutions, releases, enhancements, packaging updates, and priority commercial initiatives. Define audience, messaging, launch tier, readiness needs, asset requirements, internal communications, success measures, and post-launch feedback loops.
  • Product and Roadmap Partnership – Serve as a strategic partner to Product by bringing market, buyer, competitive, and field insights into roadmap discussions and launch planning. Translate roadmap direction and product capabilities into commercial narratives, messaging frameworks, differentiated value stories, and enablement plans that help internal teams understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to talk about it in market.
  • Enablement and Commercial Readiness – Partner with Enablement to design and activate GTM readiness for Sales, SAE, Account Management, CBR, and other customer-facing teams. Create and maintain practical enablement materials, talk tracks, objection handling, competitive guidance, discovery questions, presentations, demos, FAQs, proposal language, training content, and field-ready resources that improve confidence, consistency, and effectiveness in customer conversations.
  • Content and Asset Development – Create, curate, and maintain compelling product marketing content, including solution narratives, sales decks, one-pagers, case study inputs, demo scripts, website and campaign inputs, event messaging, proposal content, customer communications, and executive-ready materials. Use engagement data, stakeholder feedback, competitive insights, and business priorities to keep content relevant, accurate, and effective.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership and Influence – Act as a connective partner across Wellbeing GTM efforts, ensuring Product, Marketing, Enablement, Sales, SAE, Account Management, Operations, Legal, Finance, and other stakeholder groups are aligned on goals, messaging, timelines, readiness needs, and follow-through. Facilitate working sessions, capture decisions, manage dependencies, and drive clarity across complex initiatives.
  • Performance Measurement and Optimization – Define, track, and report qualitative and quantitative indicators of product marketing impact, including launch readiness, asset adoption, field feedback, campaign contribution, sales usage, win/loss themes, pipeline support, retention or expansion influence, and content effectiveness. Use results to refine messaging, improve enablement, prioritize updates, and strengthen future GTM motions.
  • Embody Personify Health's core values - People matter; one team, one dream; deliver; and grow forward.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

What you bring to the Personify Health team:

To be successful in this role, you bring the following experience and attributes:

  • BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Communications, Healthcare Administration, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree a plus.
  • 5+ years of product marketing, solution marketing, GTM, sales enablement, or related B2B marketing experience, including demonstrated ownership of positioning, messaging, launch planning, and commercial content.
  • Experience working in healthcare, employee wellbeing, health plans, benefits, navigation, advocacy, digital health, or adjacent markets required or strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with Product, Enablement, Sales, Account Management, and other cross-functional teams to translate product strategy into GTM execution and field readiness.
  • Proven ability to develop benefits-led messaging, buyer personas, competitive positioning, commercial narratives, sales tools, launch materials, and customer-facing content.

You also take pride in offering the following Core Skills, Competencies, and Characteristics:

  • Strong understanding of healthcare, wellbeing, benefits, employer, consultant/broker, and health plan buying dynamics, including trends, decision drivers, and competitive landscape.
  • Excellent storytelling skills with the ability to turn complex product capabilities into simple, differentiated, buyer-relevant messages.
  • Strong GTM planning skills, including launch strategy, audience definition, messaging development, asset planning, internal readiness, stakeholder alignment, and post-launch optimization.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with Product, Marketing, Enablement, Sales, SAE, Account Management, CBR, and other internal partners, with the confidence to influence without direct authority.
  • Experience creating and maintaining field-ready enablement assets, including sales decks, talk tracks, competitive guidance, objection handling, FAQs, demo support, proposal inputs, and training materials.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to use market research, sales feedback, campaign performance, content usage, and win/loss insights to guide decisions and improve outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholder groups, dependencies, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to create executive-ready materials and facilitate productive cross-functional discussions.
  • Accountable, collaborative, curious, commercially minded, and comfortable operating with both strategic context and hands-on execution.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Suite, especially PowerPoint; experience with Salesforce, Seismic, SharePoint, or marketing automation platforms a plus.

 Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time.
  • Must be able to operate a computer and other office productivity tools.
  • Must be able to communicate information and ideas so others can understand and exchange accurate information in these situations.
  • May occasionally need to move event materials, supplies, or equipment consistent with business needs and reasonable accommodation practices.

Disclaimer

This role portrait is not intended to contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities, but constitutes a general description of the scope and function of the role within the company. Activities, duties, and responsibilities are subject to change at any time with or without notice.

Benefits

The Highlights:

  • Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
  • Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
  • Unlimited PTO—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
  • Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
  • Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture? Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation: This position offers a base salary range of $110,000 - $120,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

Our Commitment: Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Stay Safe: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to . View all legitimate openings at personifyhealth.com/careers.

The SEO Specialist role offers an exciting opportunity to drive meaningful impact by shaping and optimizing the online presence of your assigned scope. Role Summary:

The Leader, Warehouse Systems Support oversees the performance, efficiency, and continuous improvement of warehouse systems and processes across the organization. This role serves as a liaison between warehouse operations and IT, ensuring technology, automation, and processes are optimized to support productivity, accuracy, and scalability.

The leader will manage new system implementations, drive operational excellence, and provide strategic direction for warehouse performance and system utilization. This role will require strong cross-functional collaboration to maintain operational standards and support business objectives with a focus on efficiency, quality, and safety. It also includes responsibility for the design and development of business processes within TireHub’s warehouse management systems.

This position reports to the Director, Warehousing and Logistics.

The individual must exhibit the following core TireHub commitments:

·Approachable - If a company could smile, we would. Instead, we rely on our people to show it. We care about each other and our customers because we know business only gets done right when people respect each other and value relationships.

·Adventurous - What TireHub is set up to do is intentionally outrageous. So, we readily embrace challenges with the courage to introduce new ideas and the ambition to build something unique.

·Relentless - We tackle our work with energy. We deliver on our commitments with enthusiasm. And we don't give up until we get to the end.

·Speedy - Speed is the currency in the tire industry. When we commit to a job, we get the job done – and we do it fast.

Warehouse System & Technology Management

  • Oversees inventory control, receiving, storage, order fulfillment, and shipping processes across all of TireHub WMS implementations.
  • Integrates YMS into Koerber WMS.
  • Owns the configuration, optimization, and functional support of Warehouse Management Systems into and related technologies (e.g., YMS, TMS, automation systems).

·Proficiency in writing, optimizing, and executing SQL queries using SSMS (SQL Server Management Studio).

  • Partners with IT and external vendors to implement new system features, integrations, and upgrades.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves system issues, minimizing downtime and operational disruption.
  • Documents process changes within WMS and maintains comprehensive manuals and guidelines for staff training and reference.
  • Reviews existing business workflows to ensure alignment between WMS processes and business and financial requirements.
  • Serves as primary point of contact for device connectivity and technical support.
  • Diagnosis and provide data feedback to provide solve long-term unexpected backend actions.

Leadership & People Management

  • Manages and develops a team of process leads, analysts, and operations staff.
  • Fosters a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Sets performance goals and conducts regular reviews.

Data & Analytics

  • Proficiency in writing, optimizing, and executing SQL queries using SSMS (SQL Server Management Studio).
  • Analyzes warehouse performance data and trends to recommend process improvements.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Ensures compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory standards.
  • Leads Lean, Six Sigma, and/or Kaizen initiatives to streamline workflows and reduce waste.
  • Stays current on industry trends and best practices.

Training, Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Facilitates cross-functional meetings to ensure alignment on projects and gather stakeholder input.
  • Develops and delivers training programs to ensure staff proficiency in warehouse systems and tools.

Administrative & Compliance

raw.description:
Who We Are

The Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI) is a non-partisan, non-profit dedicated to equipping the next generation of Americans with the skills to communicate and collaborate across lines of difference. We work with U.S. colleges and universities by providing co-curricular programming for students, professional development for faculty and staff, and strategic guidance to leadership. Our goal is to foster constructive dialogue at every level of the institution and to create the conditions for lasting organizational change. CDI was co-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of The Righteous Mind and The Anxious Generation.

The Role

CDI is looking for an Associate Director or Director of Development to run our fundraising operations. You’ll report directly to our Co-Founder and Executive Director, who will continue to serve as CDI’s primary fundraiser. Your role will be to enable her fundraising in two key ways: (1) by running an exceptionally organized fundraising operation behind the scenes, and (2) by being responsible for grant writing and reporting responsibilities. This role combines meaningful ownership—you’ll operate with significant autonomy—with the chance to work with an experienced fundraiser and deepen your own expertise.

We’re looking for a development generalist with two super strengths: (1) operational excellence and (2) exceptional writing and communication skills. You bring rigor and organization to everything you touch, and you can make complex ideas clear and compelling without flattening their nuance. You notice details, anticipate what’s coming, and are always looking for a smarter way to run the work.

We’re open to candidates with different levels of fundraising experience. At the Director level, you’d take on more relationship management and strategy from the start; at the Associate Director level, you’d have room to grow into those responsibilities over time. What matters most to us is that you take real pride in the quality of your work and believe deeply in CDI’s mission.

What You’ll Do

Grant Writing & Management

  • Lead development and submission of compelling grant proposals, reports, and donor materials.

  • Translate CDI’s work and impact into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with funders while staying true to CDI’s voice and strategy.

  • Collaborate closely with Finance, Marketing & Communications, and program teams across CDI to gather the content needed for grant proposals and reports.

  • Maintain an exceptionally high bar for both the quality of all grant materials and the efficiency of the processes behind them.

  • Maintain a comprehensive grants calendar; proactively manage all deadlines for grants and other funder commitments.

Development Operations

  • Own the systems and infrastructure behind CDI’s fundraising work, from HubSpot and funder records to internal workflows and documentation.

  • Maintain and refine core assets, including reusable grant content, case studies, pitch decks, templates, and annual reports.

  • Partner closely with Finance to process new contributions, track grant requirements, and maintain funder and grant documentation.

  • Keep CDI’s fundraising pipeline current and actionable; partner with Finance to translate that pipeline into revenue projections.

  • Build and continuously improve the workflows, tools, and systems that keep CDI’s fundraising function running smoothly.

Fundraising Strategy & Relationships

  • Proactively manage the preparation and follow-through around the Executive Director’s funder relationships, enabling her to focus on relationship building.

  • Support the Executive Director in shaping fundraising strategy and priorities.

  • Conduct prospect and landscape research to identify new funding opportunities and inform fundraising strategy.

  • Depending on experience, directly manage and steward a portfolio of funder relationships.

Requirements

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of experience in development or fundraising, including experience writing successful grants in the six- and seven-figure range.

  • Passionate about development operations, with experience building systems and processes that keep fundraising work running exceptionally smoothly, particularly in smaller or growing organizations.

  • An excellent writer and communicator who can make complex ideas clear and compelling for different audiences.

  • Exceptionally organized and self-directed; you keep work moving, stay ahead of deadlines, and require minimal oversight.

  • Exceptionally detail-oriented, with a very high bar for quality and accuracy.

  • Strong judgment; you notice nuance, anticipate issues before they happen, and can assess what requires attention or escalation.

  • Passionate about constructive dialogue and aligned with CDI’s values.

For the Director role, we’ll also look for:

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in development or fundraising, including 2+ years in management or leadership roles.

  • Experience owning funder relationships through cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.

  • Experience building and executing fundraising strategies to achieve philanthropic revenue goals of $1 million or more.

What We Offer

  • A Mission-Driven Culture — our work culture genuinely reflects our mission, characterized by intellectual humility, continuous improvement, and open-mindedness

  • Unlimited PTO — recharge on your own schedule with unlimited paid time off, in addition to 13 company holidays

  • Health, Vision & Dental — health, vision, and dental plans through, with CDI contributing toward your premiums each month

  • 401(k) Match — invest in your future with a 100% match on your contributions, up to 3% of your pay

  • Professional Development — an annual budget to invest in your growth: build new skills, deepen existing ones, and stay inspired in your work

  • Remote Work Support — up to $500 reimbursed for home office equipment and up to $50/month reimbursed for home internet or cell phone expenses

The Details

  • Compensation: Associate Director: $101,000–$113,000; Director: $132,000–$147,000

  • Reports to: Executive Director

  • Direct reports: None

  • Schedule: Full-time, flexible within U.S. time zones

  • Target start date: ASAP

  • Location: Remote, must be based in the U.S.


A note on AI: We know AI has become a useful writing assistant, and we’re comfortable with candidates using it that way. But when AI does too much of the writing, applications start to sound remarkably similar, making it hard for us to understand what you uniquely bring to the table. Please keep this in mind as you prepare your application.

Highlights

CDI is hiring a resourceful, detail-oriented Director of Development Operations to own our fundraising systems, relationships, and grant process, and support our Executive Director.

raw.description:
Hiring: Sr. Amazon Marketplace Manager

Company: Rain Media | Organics Ocean

Reports to:Sr. Director of Growth

Status: Full-Time/ W2/Individual Contributor

Location:Remote US-based / limited travel may be required

Do you thrive in a role that dives deep into hands-on Amazon execution while steering high-level channel strategy?

Have you successfully scaled 7- or 8-figure Amazon Seller Central accounts in the dietary supplement space while navigating strict FDA/FTC compliance?

Are you an Amazon SME who excels at managing agencies, mastering PPC/SEO, and taking total ownership of account profitability in a fast-paced, remote environment?

If you answered yes to these questions, we want to talk to you.

Position Overview

We are a high-growth, mid-sized dietary supplement brand seeking a hungry, operator-first Amazon Marketplace Manager to assume end-to-end commercial ownership, operational execution, and net profitability of our Amazon Seller Central (3P) account. Balancing hands-on execution with high-level channel strategy (roughly 70/30), you will serve as our internal Subject Matter Expert (SME), offloading daily operations from senior leadership to drive revenue in a fast-paced, remote environment. In this role, you will own keyword ranking and Amazon SEO, manage PPC campaigns, optimize listing efficiency, strictly enforce dietary supplement regulatory compliance, and direct our external agency partner to maximize output.

Who is Organics Ocean

Organics Ocean is a premium DTC supplement brand empowering health through science-backed, clean, and effective products. We are building a trusted wellness authority rooted in transparency, education, and long-term customer loyalty.

Our Culture

We operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where we constantly test, optimize, and innovate. Our team consists of high-performing operators who move with urgency and take pride in their craft. We maintain a collaborative, low-ego culture where feedback is direct, expectations are clear, and strong ideas win regardless of title. We believe our next stage of expansion requires A-players who thrive in ambiguity and hold a high bar for excellence.

To learn the founder’s story and more about Organics Ocean, visit ourwebsite and review ourCultural Pillars.

Why Join Our Team?

  • Rapid Expansion: Join an innovative eCommerce leader experiencing 350% year-over-year growth.
  • True Ownership: We trust our team to lead and execute without micromanagement. We value individuals who take initiative and drive meaningful results.
  • Elite Performance: Work alongside driven professionals in an environment built for continuous improvement and professional evolution.

What You’ll Own

Commercial Ownership & Agency Direction

  • Channel Performance: Lead day-to-day operations across Amazon Seller Central (FBA/FBM), driving top-line growth while optimizing net profitability, unit economics, TACoS, and MER.
  • Agency Oversight: Serve as the primary internal manager for our external Amazon agency. Audit their performance, set strategic direction, and leverage them as an execution resource (e.g., ticket resolution, customer service, case escalations).
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with design leads on creative assets, collaborate with the DTC team to align Shopify and Amazon strategies, and deliver clear performance visibility to leadership.

Keyword Strategy, SEO & Listing Optimization

  • SEO & Keyword SME: Conduct ongoing keyword research, competitor analysis, and index tracking. Execute strategic listing updates to capture high-volume/high-intent search terms and gain category market share.
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Execute continuous A/B testing on titles, main images, infographics, bullet points, and Storefront layouts to maximize CTR and CVR.
  • A+ Content & Brand Story: Direct the strategy and layout overhaul for A+ Content, Premium A+, and the Amazon Brand Story.

Advertising & Data Analytics

  • Full-Funnel Ad Strategy: Oversee and optimize PPC campaigns (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display) and leverage DSP/AMC strategies to capture search volume and scale market share.
  • Deep Analytics Reporting: Analyze catalog performance using native tools (Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, Search Term Reports) to evaluate search volume capture versus brand share.
  • Cross-Channel Measurement: Track SKU-level contribution margins, TACoS vs. ACoS targets, and the halo effect of DTC ad spend on Amazon search lift using analytics platforms (e.g., Triple Whale, Google Sheets).

Account Health, Compliance & Operations

  • Dietary Supplement Compliance: Enforce strict adherence to FDA guidelines, FTC structure/function claim rules, and Amazon supplement policies across all copy, images, and A+ Content.
  • Account Defense: Continuously monitor Seller Central health, Voice of the Customer (VoC) metrics, and listing statuses to quickly resolve suppressed listings, stranded inventory, and policy flags.
  • Customer Retention & Inventory: Manage Subscribe & Save performance, review acquisition strategies (including Amazon Vine), and collaborate with logistics on FBA stock forecasting.

First 3 Immediate Projects:

  1. Listing SEO & Keyword Audit: Perform an end-to-end audit and keyword optimization across all active listings.
  2. Ad Portfolio Realignment: Reallocate advertising spend across the product catalog based on keyword audit insights.
  3. Content Overhaul Strategy: Develop the roadmap to upgrade A+ Content, Premium A+, and Brand Story assets.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days:

  • Fully assume strategic direction and operational oversight of the agency relationship.
  • Capture measurable new keyword ownership and top-of-search rankings.
  • Achieve an improved distribution and efficiency of ad spend across the catalog.

In 12 Months:

  • Drive organic rank improvements for core revenue-generating SKUs.
  • Efficiently scale advertising spend to support the brand’s path toward $46M in annual revenue.

What You Bring | Must-Haves

  • 5+ Years of Amazon Seller Central (3P) Experience: Proven track record of managing end-to-end operations and driving 7- or 8-figure annual revenue growth.
  • Leadership Experience: Minimum of 2 years directly managing a team, with demonstrated experience in continuous performance coaching, team development, employee discipline, and conducting annual performance reviews.
  • Dietary Supplement / CPG Expertise: Direct experience in dietary supplements, nutraceuticals, or consumables, with a clear understanding of FDA/FTC claim compliance and category gating.
  • Agency Management: Proven background directing external agencies, auditing performance metrics, and guiding tactical execution.
  • Ad Platform Mastery: Hands-on experience with Amazon PPC (Sponsored Ads) and familiarity with native tools (Amazon DSP, Amazon Attribution, Amazon Marketing Cloud).
  • SEO, Visual & Analytics Tool Proficiency: Experience optimizing brand content for both desktop and mobile user experiences, alongside proficiency in Amazon SEO tools (e.g., Helium 10, Jungle Scout) and native reporting (Search Query Performance, Brand Analytics).
  • Financial Acumen: Strong proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel for analyzing TACoS vs. ACoS, contribution margins, and SKU-level unit economics.
  • Ability to accommodate limited required travel
  • Willingness to work US time zones, regardless of geographic location.
  • Access to a computer, a reliable internet connection, and a distraction-free work environment

Ideal Candidate

  • Operator Mindset: Heavily execution-focused (70% operator / 30% strategist) with a scrappy, self-motivated work style.
  • Remote Autonomy: Comfortable operating independently using ClickUp, Slack, Dropbox, and Google Workspace.
  • Problem Solver: Calm and systematic when navigating platform updates, stranded inventory, or Seller Support escalations.

Offer Details

  • Pay: $115,000 – $175,000. Final base salary within this range will be determined based on multiple factors, including candidate location, relevant skills, depth of experience, scope of responsibilities, applicable licenses or credentials, and internal equity.
  • Time Off: 15 days of PTO + 10 paid U.S. holidays per year
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive healthcare, dental, and vision plans
  • Financial Growth: 401(k) with a best-in-class company match
  • Perks: Exclusive employee product discounts

Software Utilized by the Company

ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace, Dropbox, Triple Whale, Aspire, Canva, Everflow, Figma, Google Meet, A2X, QuickBooks

Our Interview Process

Our selection process involves an Application review, HR Interview, and Hiring Manager Interview. Depending on the role, candidates may also complete a Paid Project and a final interview with our Director, VP, or CEO. Because we take great care in selecting our team, our hiring timeline may adjust based on business needs to ensure the best long-term fit.

We're looking for bilingual speakers to record short, casual voice clips where they naturally mix English with Chinese - the way they'd actually talk in real life. No script, no scenarios, just you talking about your day, your opinions, whatever comes naturally.

Do you switch between English and Chinese mid-sentence without even thinking about it? Rant about your day, discuss your favorite show, think out loud with different languages - say it exactly how you'd say it to a friend. What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities:

  • Record 1-2 minute voice clips responding to a prompt or reacting to a short video
  • Speak naturally, switching between English and Chinese the way you normally would in everyday conversation

Requirements

  • Language: Fully bilingual - fluent or native in both English and Chinese, and someone who naturally mixes the two when speaking
  • Equipment: Any device works, including your phone - no studio or special equipment needed

raw.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍UK Remote | 💰£68,400 to £89,575 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

⭐️ Our Ops Labs Team

We’re building Ops Labs: a small, high-impact team focused on incubating, testing and scaling new ideas that improve customer experience and create enterprise value for Monzo.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, data and experimentation. You’ll take ideas from concept to reality - rapidly testing hypotheses, learning what works (and what doesn’t), and turning the best ideas into scalable solutions across Operations.

Many of these ideas will come from our strategy work, customer insight, and experience gaps. Your job is to turn them into tangible experiments, validate their impact, and help scale the ones that meaningfully improve customer outcomes, reduce cost, or unlock new value.

This is a zero-to-one role. You’ll need to be comfortable operating with high ambiguity, building structure where none exists, and working hands-on to bring ideas to life.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

  • Turning ideas into real-world experiments - Take ideas emerging from strategy, customer insights, and experience gaps, and translate them into testable hypotheses. Design and execute experiments end-to-end — from scoping and setup to execution, measurement and readout — with a strong bias to action and speed.
  • Incubating high-potential opportunities - Identify and develop early-stage ideas that could significantly improve customer experience, reduce operational demand, or create commercial value. This could include rethinking service models, testing new ways to deliver support, or exploring entirely new capabilities within Ops.
  • Scaling successful experiments into production - Work closely with product, engineering, data science and operations teams to take successful pilots and scale them. Ensure there is a clear path from experiment → validated impact → operational or product integration.
  • Advancing goodwill and customer experience innovation - Reimagine how we deliver goodwill and recover from poor experiences — testing new approaches that improve customer trust while being sustainable and scalable. Push beyond incremental fixes to meaningfully raise the bar for customer experience.
  • Creating strong feedback loops with data science and CX insights - Partner closely with Customer Experience, Data Science and Insights teams to ensure experiments are informed by real customer pain points, and that we rigorously track the impact of changes (e.g. what actually improves CSAT, reduces complaints, or drives engagement).
  • Measuring impact and building the case for change - Define clear success metrics for experiments (CSAT, demand reduction, cost, engagement, etc.), track outcomes, and communicate results clearly. Build compelling cases to scale, iterate, or stop initiatives based on evidence.
  • Working hands-on with frontline operations (COps) - Collaborate closely with COps to test ideas in real environments. Use their feedback and expertise to refine experiments and ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and grounded in reality.
  • Pave the way for building a bigger experimentation engine - Depending on how successful the experiments are, scale the team to make the remit bigger and accelerate commercial opportunities.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have experience in strategy, product, operations, or a similar role, with a track record of taking ideas from concept to execution
  • You are highly comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy building from zero to one
  • You have strong problem-solving skills and can structure and break down complex, unclear problems
  • You have a bias to action and are comfortable testing ideas quickly rather than over-optimising upfront
  • You are analytical and able to define success metrics, interpret results, and make data-informed decisions
  • You are a strong communicator, able to clearly articulate ideas, experiments, and outcomes to different audiences
  • You are collaborative and can work effectively across functions (Ops, Product, Data, Engineering)
  • You are pragmatic and outcome-focused, balancing speed with quality and impact
  • You are curious about customer experience and motivated to improve it in meaningful ways

The following would be a bonus:

    • Experience running experiments (A/B testing, pilots, operational trials, etc.)
    • Experience working on zero-to-one products, services, or initiatives
    • Experience in operations, customer support, or service design
    • Experience working closely with data science or analytics teams
    • Experience in a high-growth or fast-changing environment.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

  • Application questions - We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here
  • Recruiter Call - 30 mins
  • 1st stage Technical Interview - 1 hour
  • and if you pass the 1st stage, a 2nd stage interview with case study.

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £68,400 to £89,575 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

⏰ This role requires you to work 40 hours a week, Monday - Friday between core hours 8am - 6pm.

📍This role is within the UK - we cannot sponsor Visas for this role

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we'll always work around your availability. You'll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process, but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact

This role will close when we feel we have received enough suitable applications, so please apply early.

Good luck 🍀

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

We combine deep technical and management expertise to solve complex challenges, enhance capabilities, and drive competitive growth. Our clients include some of the largest banking, insurance and investment firms in the United States.

We are seeking a VP, Account Executive with proven sales expertise in the Consumer and Commercial Banking sectors. This individual will be responsible for driving new client acquisition and expanding relationships with existing accounts, focusing on banking executives, institutional decision makers, and technology leaders. By combining consultative selling skills, deep industry knowledge, and an entrepreneurial approach, the Account Executive will identify opportunities, build trusted relationships, and deliver tailored solutions that address client needs across banking technology, operations, and services.

The ideal candidate will have experience managing complex sales cycles with C-Suite executives and senior stakeholders in financial institutions, including both short-term opportunities and multi-year engagements. They will excel at uncovering business challenges, positioning high-value consulting and technology solutions, and ensuring client satisfaction through ongoing engagement and partnership.

This is a full-time, remote role with occasional travel required for client meetings, industry events, and relationship development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to drive new business and grow existing client accounts within the consumer and commercial banking sector.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with C-Suite executives, senior decision makers, and institutional leaders to understand their challenges and position high-value solutions.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, lead qualification, proposal development, negotiation, and contract closure.
  • Collaborate with internal consulting and delivery teams to align solutions with client requirements and ensure seamless handoff from sales to execution.
  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities to expand client relationships beyond initial engagements.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitive offerings to position Hobbs Madison as a trusted partner.
  • Represent the company at client meetings, conferences, and industry events to strengthen brand presence and expand networks.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline management, and client interaction records using CRM tools.
  • Ensure client satisfaction by engaging regularly to uncover evolving needs and position new opportunities.
About You
  • 7+ years of technical consultative sales experience within the Consumer and/or Commercial Banking, Investment Firms, or Financial Services industry.
  • Deep understanding of banking operations, digital transformation initiatives, and technology-driven solutions.
  • Strong experience working with C-Suite executives and senior decision makers in financial institutions.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets and successfully managing both short and long sales cycles.
  • Ability to balance strategic planning with tactical execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify, pursue, and close new business opportunities.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Exceptional work ethic, positive attitude, strong integrity, and drive to succeed
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for client meetings and events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or related field required; MBA a plus.

Our History

Founded in 2002, Hobbs Madison Inc. is a consulting firm specializing in technology and business solutions for the financial services industry. We partner with leading banks, insurance companies, and investor services firms to maximize existing platforms, implement innovative solutions, and deliver results quickly.

Our senior consultants average 15+ years of industry and technology experience, combining technical expertise, business insight, and clear communication to solve complex challenges. Known for our speed, precision, and collaborative approach, we help clients navigate change, improve capabilities, and strengthen their competitive edge.

Hobbs Madison has established a reputation among its clients as one of the leading Strategy and IT Consultants in the U.S. for the financial services industry.

raw.description:
Performance Marketing Specialist – Google Ads, Meta Ads & Paid Media | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Preferred Locations: Pakistan, LATAM, South Africa, Philippines

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Performance Marketing Specialist to manage, optimize, and scale paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other digital channels.

This is a hands-on paid media role focused on measurable growth and acquisition performance — not simply campaign coordination.

You’ll own campaign execution, budget optimization, conversion tracking, A/B testing, attribution, and performance reporting, with a focus on improving ROAS, CPA, CPL, and conversion rates.

You’ll collaborate with creative, content, sales, and marketing teams to turn advertising spend into qualified leads, customers, and revenue.

If you’re a data-driven marketer who enjoys testing, optimizing, and scaling campaigns, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Paid Media Campaign Management

  • Build, launch, and manage campaigns across:
    • Google Ads
    • Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
    • LinkedIn Ads
    • Other relevant paid channels
  • Manage campaigns focused on lead generation, customer acquisition, sales, revenue, and brand growth
  • Develop and test audiences, messaging, creatives, and campaign structures
  • Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, targeting, and placements
  • Scale winning campaigns while maintaining performance efficiency

Campaign Optimization & Growth

  • Monitor campaign performance and optimize accounts regularly
  • Improve key metrics including:
    • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
    • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
    • Cost Per Lead (CPL)
    • Click-Through Rate (CTR)
    • Conversion Rate
  • Identify underperforming campaigns and implement improvements
  • Test new channels, audiences, formats, and acquisition strategies
  • Scale successful campaigns based on performance data

A/B Testing & Experimentation

  • Develop and execute structured tests across:
    • Ad creatives
    • Copy and messaging
    • Audiences
    • Landing pages
    • Offers
    • Bidding strategies
  • Analyze test results and identify winning variations
  • Use campaign learnings to continuously improve acquisition performance

Analytics, Attribution & Conversion Tracking

  • Track campaign performance using:
    • Google Analytics
    • Google Tag Manager
    • Advertising platform dashboards
  • Monitor CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, and conversion rates
  • Maintain accurate conversion tracking and attribution
  • Analyze funnel performance from ad click through conversion
  • Troubleshoot tracking issues and data inconsistencies
  • Identify performance trends and growth opportunities through campaign data

Funnel & Conversion Optimization

  • Understand the full customer acquisition journey from impression to conversion
  • Identify funnel drop-offs and recommend improvements
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to improve lead quality
  • Support landing page and conversion rate optimization initiatives
  • Ensure paid acquisition campaigns align with revenue and business growth objectives

Reporting & Performance Insights

  • Prepare weekly and monthly campaign reports
  • Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Monitor budget utilization and campaign efficiency
  • Identify opportunities to scale profitable campaigns
  • Communicate performance trends, challenges, and recommendations to stakeholders

Creative & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with designers and content teams on advertising assets
  • Provide data-backed feedback on:
    • Ad creative
    • Copy
    • Offers
    • Landing pages
  • Collaborate with sales teams to understand lead quality and downstream conversion
  • Help align paid acquisition with broader marketing initiatives

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on performance marketing or paid media experience
  • Proven experience managing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or similar platforms
  • Strong understanding of:
    • PPC
    • Paid acquisition
    • Conversion tracking
    • Attribution
    • Funnel optimization
    • Audience targeting
  • Experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and advertising platform analytics
  • Demonstrated ability to:
    • Improve ROAS
    • Reduce CPA and CPL
    • Optimize conversion rates
    • Scale successful campaigns
  • Experience managing advertising budgets and multiple campaigns
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing both lead generation and e-commerce campaigns
  • Experience managing multiple advertising accounts or client portfolios
  • Familiarity with:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Marketo
    • CRM and marketing automation platforms
  • Google Ads and/or Meta Ads certifications
  • Experience within:
    • SaaS
    • Marketing agencies
    • Professional services
    • High-growth startups
  • Understanding of lifecycle marketing and audience segmentation

Tools & Platforms

Google Ads | Meta Ads | LinkedIn Ads | Google Analytics | Google Tag Manager | HubSpot | Salesforce | Marketo | CRM & Marketing Automation Platforms

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Make decisions based on data rather than assumptions
  • Enjoy testing and continuously improving campaigns
  • Understand how paid media connects to the entire acquisition funnel
  • Can diagnose why a campaign is underperforming and take action
  • Are comfortable managing multiple campaigns and budgets simultaneously
  • Balance creative experimentation with performance discipline
  • Focus on profitable growth rather than vanity metrics
  • Can execute independently while collaborating effectively across teams

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start by reviewing campaign dashboards, spend, conversions, CPA, CPL, and ROAS across active accounts.

From there, you’ll optimize budgets and bids, pause underperforming ads, scale winning campaigns, analyze audience performance, and launch new tests.

Throughout the day, you may collaborate with creative teams on new ad concepts, review landing-page performance, troubleshoot tracking issues, and analyze lead or revenue quality with sales and marketing teams.

In short: you turn paid advertising budgets into measurable, scalable business growth.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
  • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
  • Cost Per Lead (CPL)
  • Click-Through Rate (CTR)
  • Conversion Rate
  • Lead and revenue growth
  • Budget efficiency
  • Campaign scalability
  • Conversion tracking accuracy

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Hands-on ownership of paid acquisition campaigns
  • Work across major platforms including Google, Meta, and LinkedIn
  • Direct impact on leads, customers, and revenue
  • Opportunity to test and scale new acquisition strategies
  • Strong exposure to performance analytics and funnel optimization
  • Fully remote environment
  • Growth opportunities into roles such as:
    • Senior Performance Marketing Specialist
    • Paid Media Manager
    • Growth Marketing Manager
    • Head of Performance Marketing

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Initial Interview with Pavago
  4. Technical / Performance Marketing Interview
  5. Final Interview with Leadership
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have hands-on experience managing Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or other paid acquisition channels and know how to use data to improve ROAS, CPA, CPL, and conversions, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build and scale high-performing paid acquisition campaigns.
