Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

At Personify Health, we value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe in creating teams made up of individuals with various backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Why? Because diversity inspires innovation, collaboration, and challenges us to produce better solutions. But more than this, diversity is our strength, and a catalyst in our ability to create a personalized experience for our clients and members. Because #healthispersonal.

Responsibilities

What You'll Actually Do

Who are you?

As a Product Marketing Manager for the Wellbeing business at Personify Health, you will help define how our wellbeing solutions show up in market, connect to buyer needs, and enable revenue teams to communicate differentiated value with confidence. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Enablement, Sales, SAE, Account Management, CBR, and other cross-functional teams, translating product capabilities, market insights, and customer needs into clear positioning, compelling messaging, practical go-to-market plans, and high-impact commercial content.

You will be responsible for understanding the Wellbeing portfolio, priority audiences, competitive landscape, sales motions, buyer challenges, and product roadmap. You will craft benefits-led narratives, launch plans, enablement assets, buyer-facing content, and internal readiness materials that help teams bring the right message to the right audience at the right moment. Your work will support acquisition, retention, expansion, adoption, and stronger commercial execution across the Wellbeing business.

You are a strategic, hands-on product marketer who can simplify complexity, influence across teams, and move work from insight to execution. You are comfortable partnering closely with Product to understand roadmap direction, with Enablement to activate GTM motions, and with Sales, SAE, Account Management, and other commercial teams to ensure messaging, assets, and training are useful, current, and aligned to real customer conversations. You bring strong storytelling, business judgment, project ownership, and a bias for measurable impact.

In this role, your work will be essential in the following areas:

Many of these responsibilities will be delivered in partnership with cross-functional teams and aligned to business priorities, product roadmap needs, and defined areas of specialization.

  • Market, Buyer, and Competitive Expertise – Build and maintain a deep understanding of the Wellbeing market, priority segments, buyer personas, influencers, customer needs, industry trends, sales motions, and competitive dynamics. Regularly synthesize win/loss insights, sales conversations, customer feedback, analyst or market inputs, and competitive intelligence to inform positioning, enablement, GTM strategy, and roadmap feedback.

  • Go-to-Market Strategy and Launch Readiness – Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Enablement, Sales, SAE, Account Management, CBR, and other teams to plan, coordinate, and execute GTM motions for new solutions, releases, enhancements, packaging updates, and priority commercial initiatives. Define audience, messaging, launch tier, readiness needs, asset requirements, internal communications, success measures, and post-launch feedback loops.
  • Product and Roadmap Partnership – Serve as a strategic partner to Product by bringing market, buyer, competitive, and field insights into roadmap discussions and launch planning.   • Enablement and Commercial Readiness – Partner with Enablement to design and activate GTM readiness for Sales, SAE, Account Management, CBR, and other customer-facing teams.   • Content and Asset Development – Create, curate, and maintain compelling product marketing content, including solution narratives, sales decks, one-pagers, case study inputs, demo scripts, website and campaign inputs, event messaging, proposal content, customer communications, and executive-ready materials. Use engagement data, stakeholder feedback, competitive insights, and business priorities to keep content relevant, accurate, and effective.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership and Influence – Act as a connective partner across Wellbeing GTM efforts, ensuring Product, Marketing, Enablement, Sales, SAE, Account Management, Operations, Legal, Finance, and other stakeholder groups are aligned on goals, messaging, timelines, readiness needs, and follow-through. Facilitate working sessions, capture decisions, manage dependencies, and drive clarity across complex initiatives.
  • Performance Measurement and Optimization – Define, track, and report qualitative and quantitative indicators of product marketing impact, including launch readiness, asset adoption, field feedback, campaign contribution, sales usage, win/loss themes, pipeline support, retention or expansion influence, and content effectiveness. Use results to refine messaging, improve enablement, prioritize updates, and strengthen future GTM motions.
  • Embody Personify Health's core values - People matter; one team, one dream; deliver; and grow forward.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Join Superformula as an SEO & AEO Specialist to help our brand portfolio get discovered across traditional search and AI-powered experiences, including ChatGPT, Google’s AI search features, and Perplexity. Answer engine optimization (AEO) is a core focus of this role. You’ll partner with business, content, and technology teams to develop strategies, improve content and technical foundations, and test what drives visibility, qualified traffic, and business results.

Requirements

The SEO Specialist role offers an exciting opportunity to drive meaningful impact by shaping and optimizing the online presence of your assigned scope. In this dynamic position, you’ll work closely with business teams and technology partners to deeply understand their organic search goals and craft tailored strategies to measure, improve, and execute on key growth areas. Through your efforts, you’ll elevate our brand portfolio’s visibility within search engines, leveraging techniques like enhanced copywriting, precise tagging, and innovative optimization practices to achieve measurable results.

As a valued member of the collaborative SEO Guild, you’ll actively share insights and work alongside a network of talented SEO Specialists and technology professionals, fostering innovation and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities will include crafting high-performing SEO copy, designing effective tags that boost visibility while enhancing accessibility, and contributing to the development and use of cutting-edge in-house SEO tools. These tools, powered by generative AI, will enable you to excel in tasks such as keyword research, optimized content creation, and delivering timely reports on SEO performance trends. Together, these efforts will ensure a lasting positive impact on the digital strategy and success of your assigned scope.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Marketing, or related field; or equivalent education and work experience

  • At least (3) three years of experience in SEO/SEM, digital product, and web design

  • Previous experience working with an enterprise web analytics platform (e.g. Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics) and Google business

  • Hands-on experience with AEO or generative engine optimization (GEO), including testing how brands and content appear in AI-generated answers.

  • Previous experience working with web technologies and HTML-based code frameworks

  • Resident in a time zone whose standard workday has a 6-hour overlap with the 9-5 work hours of the Pacific timezone; South

  • America and North America

Preferred Credentials

  • Previous experience with digital or web analytics for a hospitality or travel company

  • Previous experience working in a resort industry setting

  • Develop and execute an AEO strategy alongside our SEO program, identifying the questions and topics that matter most to our guests and businesses.

  • Partner with content and engineering teams to improve content clarity, factual accuracy, structure, and technical accessibility across search and AI answer platforms.

  • Establish a repeatable approach to testing and reporting on AI visibility, including brand mentions, citations, competitive presence, and referral traffic and conversions where measurable. Use findings to prioritize improvements.

  • Master's Degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, MIS, Mathematics, or Statistics

  • Strong understanding of search algorithms and how various content and linking strategies affect results

  • Working knowledge of how to manage multiple business entities with Google’s business platforms

  • Ability to partner with the assigned business team, IT, and digital design to identify specific landing page strategies to maximize search exposure

  • Excellent communication skills (English)

  • Strong interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with all stakeholders and partners

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Ability to multitask on different tasks; copywriting, projects, research, and reporting

Principal Duties & Responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day operation of GMB and SEO/SEM analytics efforts to improve organic search results through various SEO techniques

  • Collaborate with assigned business teams to identify strategies to maximize search exposure, including local search (GMB - Google My Business)

  • Make recommendations to improve site and internal/external linking architecture, page construction, meta-data, content, and SEO copywriting

  • Create, manage, and distribute data and insights via regular and ad-hoc reporting utilizing online analytic tools as well as traditional BI platforms; publish reporting and analytics on keyword analysis and search performance to internal stakeholders

  • Help identify, develop and implement processes and procedures to regularly test and improve search performance

  • Keep abreast of new features and functionality released within our analytics platforms and recommend how to best utilize these to grow our knowledge

  • Provide thought leadership in the area of search engine optimization

  • Backlinks - audit and manage backlinks. Keep high-quality and disavow low quality. We have 800K of these and have no idea who is pointing to us

  • Manage Technical SEO - page speed, broken links, responsiveness

  • On-Page Optimizations - optimize tags, and meta-data

  • Competitive Analysis - analyze competitors and recommend improvements we can make

  • Keyword Research - determine keywords that our guests use and make recommendations for on-page optimizations

Highlights

Seeking SEO & AEO Specialists! Join us & craft SEO & AEO strategies, optimize content, and leverage AI tools in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where innovation and results thrive!

Leader, Warehouse Systems Support

Role Summary:

The Leader, Warehouse Systems Support oversees the performance, efficiency, and continuous improvement of warehouse systems and processes across the organization. This role serves as a liaison between warehouse operations and IT, ensuring technology, automation, and processes are optimized to support productivity, accuracy, and scalability.

The leader will manage new system implementations, drive operational excellence, and provide strategic direction for warehouse performance and system utilization. This role will require strong cross-functional collaboration to maintain operational standards and support business objectives with a focus on efficiency, quality, and safety. It also includes responsibility for the design and development of business processes within TireHub’s warehouse management systems.

This position reports to the Director, Warehousing and Logistics.

The individual must exhibit the following core TireHub commitments:

·Approachable - If a company could smile, we would. Instead, we rely on our people to show it. We care about each other and our customers because we know business only gets done right when people respect each other and value relationships.

·Adventurous - What TireHub is set up to do is intentionally outrageous. So, we readily embrace challenges with the courage to introduce new ideas and the ambition to build something unique.

·Relentless - We tackle our work with energy. We deliver on our commitments with enthusiasm. And we don't give up until we get to the end.

·Speedy - Speed is the currency in the tire industry. When we commit to a job, we get the job done – and we do it fast. 

Role Specifics:

Warehouse System & Technology Management

  • Oversees inventory control, receiving, storage, order fulfillment, and shipping processes across all of TireHub WMS implementations.
  • Integrates YMS into Koerber WMS.
  • Owns the configuration, optimization, and functional support of Warehouse Management Systems into and related technologies (e.g., YMS, TMS, automation systems).

·Proficiency in writing, optimizing, and executing SQL queries using SSMS (SQL Server Management Studio).

  • Partners with IT and external vendors to implement new system features, integrations, and upgrades.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves system issues, minimizing downtime and operational disruption.
  • Documents process changes within WMS and maintains comprehensive manuals and guidelines for staff training and reference.
  • Reviews existing business workflows to ensure alignment between WMS processes and business and financial requirements.
  • Serves as primary point of contact for device connectivity and technical support.
  • Diagnosis and provide data feedback to provide solve long-term unexpected backend actions.

Leadership & People Management

  • Manages and develops a team of process leads, analysts, and operations staff.
  • Fosters a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Sets performance goals and conducts regular reviews.

Data & Analytics

  • Proficiency in writing, optimizing, and executing SQL queries using SSMS (SQL Server Management Studio).
  • Analyzes warehouse performance data and trends to recommend process improvements.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Ensures compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory standards.
  • Leads Lean, Six Sigma, and/or Kaizen initiatives to streamline workflows and reduce waste.
  • Stays current on industry trends and best practices.

Training, Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Facilitates cross-functional meetings to ensure alignment on projects and gather stakeholder input.
  • Develops and delivers training programs to ensure staff proficiency in warehouse systems and tools.

Administrative & Compliance

  • Ensures individual personal adherence to TireHub policies, procedures, and guidelines.
  • Participates and maintains ongoing training requirements through in-person, virtual or computer-based learning modules as assigned.
  • Completes other tasks assigned by their supervisor or another member of Leadership, as requested.

·Leadership: Exhibits courageous people leadership with ability to motivate and develop technical teams.

  • Optimizes Work Processes: Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on safety and continuous improvement​.
  • Manages Ambiguity: Operating effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear​.
  • Drives Results: Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances​.
  • Collaborates: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Knows the most effective and efficient processes to get things done. Focuses on continuous improvement ensuring safe work practices are followed.

Education & Experience:

·Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration or related field preferred.

·7+ years of experience in in warehouse or distribution operations.

·2+ years of leadership experience overseeing WMS or similar systems.

·Experience leading remote teams with a proven track record.

·Experience with implementation of Koerber WMS, preferred.

·Experience with KPI management.

  • Experience with process improvement and an understanding of Lean methodologies.
  • Experience working within a multi-site or distributed operations environment.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Strong leadership and team-building skills.

·Demonstrated ability to influence, listen and communicate effectively to diverse groups.

  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

What You Can Expect

Zoom is hiring five dedicated PLG (Product-Led Growth) Marketing Leads to own organic growth for five of its highest-priority AI products — each role reporting directly into the CEO org.


This is an individual contributor role at the intersection of product marketing, organic growth, and AI-native content creation. You'll shape how users discover and adopt Zoom's productivity products—from product insight through content creation, distribution, and measurement. This is an organic-only role—there is no paid activation budget. All growth will be driven through content, SEO/AEO, social, and conversion optimization.


About the Team

The Zoom productivity team is building a new AI-native way to work—helping users move faster from conversation and ideation to polished, editable deliverables. As the product grows, this role will help more users understand its value and adopt it in their daily work. We're a product-led team looking for someone with sharp product judgment, hands-on content execution, and a genuine understanding of how people work and what earns their attention.


Responsibilities — Focus: Acquisition & Sign-up

  • Develop deep working knowledge of Zoom's productivity products: who uses them, what problems they solve, how they compare to alternatives, and where their real advantages lie.
  • Translate product positioning and messaging for PLG audiences that starts with the user problem, not the feature list—translating product capabilities into clear, outcome-oriented value.
  • Own end-to-end content creation and publication—including demos, tutorials, comparisons, social posts, emails, and web copy—from concept through measurement.
  • Use AI tools across the full content workflow—research, scripting, demo creation, editing, and iteration—to move quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • Own the acquisition and sign-up funnel: build a repeatable content and distribution engine to drive organic discovery, landing page conversion, and sign-up completion.
  • Optimize landing pages, signup flows, and run CRO experiments to improve conversion rates.
  • Execute SEO and AEO content to improve organic discoverability and drive qualified traffic.
  • Create and distribute platform-native content across X, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, TikTok, and Instagram Reels—matching format and depth to each platform's audience while maintaining Zoom brand guidelines.
  • Track what's working using engagement, trial, subscription, and adoption signals—then use those findings to improve content and calls to action.
  • Partner with Online Marketing on email campaigns and in-product activation—ensuring messaging consistency and coordinated user journeys.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, engineers, and marketing teams to keep product stories accurate and moving at the pace of product development.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years PLG experience in product marketing, content marketing, growth marketing, or social content, with focus on digital products (SaaS, AI tools, productivity platforms, or creator products).
  • Strong product instincts: ability to identify the most important user problems, recognize genuine differentiators, and turn those into product stories that are simple, specific, and credible.
  • Practical fluency using AI tools for research, scripting, demo creation, video editing, and content iteration—demonstrated through shipped work, not just familiarity.
  • Demonstrated ability to personally create and publish end-to-end work: product videos, screen-recorded demos, and social content for digital products.
  • Strong understanding of how audiences, content formats, and distribution differ across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn—with demonstrated depth on multiple platforms.
  • Track record of building from scratch: cold-starting a content channel, product launch, or distribution system and driving it forward through ambiguity (candidates who have built and grown their own content channels with measurable results are encouraged to apply).
  • Comfort with rapid experimentation and scrappy execution: a willingness to test unconventional approaches, learn from what doesn't work, and iterate quickly without needing perfect conditions or established playbooks.
  • Experience at an AI-native, SaaS, productivity, or creator-product company is preferred—though not required if the work demonstrates the right instincts and execution ability.


Location: We are open to remote candidates in the US, or hybrid at our San Jose or Seattle offices.

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$97,600.00

Maximum:

$225,700.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.


Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.


We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations.


Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Background

  • Check out Magic's Business Profile

💰 UNCAPPED COMMISSIONS — the more you close, the more you earn. No ceiling.
Top performers hit 80–150% of monthly target consistently. At 100% quota: $3,500–$4,500/mo. At 150%: $5,000+/mo. All USD, paid monthly.

The Opportunity
50+ warm inbound leads every month. Your job is to own them — from discovery to close.

Magic connects fast-growing U.S. businesses with high-quality remote talent. Leads are warm. Playbook is proven. Earnings are uncapped. We welcome candidates from B2B, B2C, outbound, CS, and AM backgrounds — if you have grit and closing instincts, we want to talk.

Our Hiring ProcessWe move fast for strong candidates.
  • Stage 1 — 4 quick questions + Video Assessment (sent immediately)
    • Four dropdown questions under 3 minutes. Shortlisted candidates receive a Typeform video assessment immediately — 3 prompts, 60–90 seconds each. The video is how we meet you and evaluate your instincts. No live call at this stage.
  • Stage 2 — HR Background Check (45 minutes)
    • Quick call to confirm background, availability, and compensation fit.
  • Stage 3 — Sales Leadership Interview + Live Role Play + Final Panel
    • Sales Leadership runs a live mock discovery call to see your closing instincts, followed by a deeper interview.
  • Stage 4 — Offer within 48 hours
    • Decision and offer issued within 48 hours of your final stage.
What You'll Get
  • 💰 UNCAPPED COMMISSIONS — top performers earn $4,000+/month consistently
  • 50+ warm inbound leads per month — you close, we source
  • Structured playbook and active coaching from Sales Leadership
  • Career path: Sales Executive → Senior → Team Lead
  • 100% remote — USD pay monthly regardless of where you are based
What Winning Looks Like
  • You handle 2–8 discovery calls per day and never drop the ball on follow-up
  • You run 15+ quality discovery calls per week with C-level and Director-level prospects
  • You treat every "not now" as a future win — working deals with patience, creativity, and discipline
  • You own your pipeline: HubSpot is clean, next steps are always set, and nothing falls through the cracks
  • You hit quota monthly and look for ways to exceed it

The Impact you'll make

  • Own the full sales cycle — from inbound discovery call through close and client onboarding handoff
  • Uncover pain, establish urgency, and match the right Magic product to each prospect's specific needs
  • Manage a high-volume pipeline with discipline: prioritize, follow up persistently, and update deal stages in real time
  • Collaborate with Support and Ops to ensure clients start strong and stay happy
  • Share deal insights with the team; apply feedback fast and adapt when strategies evolve
  • Treat personal growth as part of the job — seek coaching, apply it, and continuously improve your close rate

Required Experience

We Welcome All of These Backgrounds
  • B2B sales — SaaS, subscription, outsourcing, professional services, tech
  • B2C sales — insurance, real estate, financial products, retail finance, automotive, telecom (any quota-carrying, consultative B2C role)
  • Outbound sales — cold calling, SDR/BDR promoted to closing, field sales, door-to-door. Grit polish.
  • Customer Success or Account Management — if you have aggressive upselling behavior and close new business (not passive relationship management)
  • Any role where you carried a number, owned a pipeline, and were personally accountable for results
Skills Style
  • Consultative approach — uncover pain before you pitch
  • English at C1 or C2 — clear, confident with U.S. buyers
  • CRM discipline — HubSpot or equivalent, pipeline always current
  • Self-accountable — you own your numbers
Mindset
  • Hungry — you hate leaving potential on the table
  • Gritty — you keep pushing when deals get hard because that's where wins are
  • Coachable — feedback is fuel, not criticism
  • Accountable — you own your outcomes, you don't wait to be told what to fix
This Role Is NOT For You If:
  • You wait for a manager to tell you what to do each day
  • You treat 'not now' as a dead end instead of a future deal to nurture
  • You blame leads, tools, or the process when numbers fall short
  • You see CRM hygiene as optional admin work
  • You need perfect leads to perform — you make the most of what's in front of you

Benefits

Your Offer
  • Guaranteed Base - $1,500 – $2,500 monthly foundation for stability
  • Performance Commission - 15–25%, increasing with performance excellence
  • Average Commission Reality - $1,500 – $2,000 monthly (what most AEs earn)
  • Total Monthly Earnings - $2,500 – $4,500+ with a clear path to increase
  • Truly Uncapped Commission - Our top performers consistently earn $5,000+ monthly
  • Employment Type - Independent Contractor/Consultant – Full Time
  • Workplace Type - Fully Remote
  • Reporting To - Inbound Sales Manager

Your Growth Path
  • Account Executive (0–6 months): Master Magic’s product suite, build pipeline discipline, establish consultative selling habits
  • Senior Account Executive (6–18 months): Consistently exceed quota, mentor new AEs, manage higher-value accounts
  • Team Lead / Sales Manager (18–36 months): Lead a pod of AEs, own team targets, contribute to sales strategy
  • Sales Director (3+ years): Oversee sales operations, drive go-to-market strategy, partner with leadership on growth

Key Time Zone Schedule Requirements
  • Work Schedule: 9-hour shifts following US business hours
  • Training Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (mandatory attendance)
  • Time Zone Alignment: Must be able to consistently work in Eastern Time, including adjustments for Daylight Saving Time and other US time zones
  • Availability: Monday to Friday, with consistent availability during U.S. business hours

Equipment Requirements (Self-Provided)
  • Computer/laptop meeting company specifications
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload)
  • Professional headset for clear client communication
  • Quiet, distraction-free work environment—all calls and interviews must be conducted from a professional, stationary setup (not while walking or commuting)
  • Backup power/internet solution for uninterrupted client service

Client Overview:
Our client is an Azerbaijani telecommunications company, the largest mobile network operator in Azerbaijan. The main products are: Fixed telephony, Mobile telephony, Internet services, Wireless broadband, and Value-added services.

The primary goal is to accelerate the client’s Data & AI initiatives via a secure, hybrid cloud foundation on AWS while systematically modernizing the IT estate as part of the cloud migration.

Key Project Objectives include:

  • Cloud Foundation & Landing Zone: Deploy target hybrid network architectures, establishing a secure Landing Zone and hybrid Data/AI platforms on AWS.
  • Security, Compliance & Governance: Operationalize on-prem tokenization (achieving zero raw PII in the cloud), resolve policy blockers to include AWS in the ISMS, and establish a Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) to govern Cloud adoption.
  • AI Chatbot & Voicebot Design & Implementation: Develop and operationalize a flagship Customer Care Chatbot and Voicebot as the first hybrid-setup consumer.

Responsibilities:

  • Build, operationalize, and automate end-to-end MLOps pipelines using Amazon SageMaker Pipelines and MLflow for experiment tracking, model versioning, and registry lifecycle management.
  • Design, deploy, and manage production SageMaker inference endpoints (real-time, serverless, and batch) and Amazon Bedrock API integrations for LLM/SLM deployment with cost controls and latency optimization (Bedrock API Gatekeeper).
  • Implement AgentOps / LLMOps frameworks (AgentCore, Bedrock Guardrails, Promptfoo) to manage multi-agent orchestration, prompt evaluation, safety guardrails, and RAG retrieval pipelines.
  • Operationalize real-time STT / TTS (Speech-to-Text / Text-to-Speech) voicebot pipelines and low-latency speech inference on hybrid/cloud GPU node pools for the flagship Customer Care Voicebot.
  • Optimize specialized GPU node pools (NVIDIA A100/L40S / EC2 GPU instance types) for Azerbaijani SLM/LLM model training, fine-tuning, and scalable inference workloads.
  • Establish automated CI/CD for Machine Learning using GitLab CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or AWS CDK) to enforce security-gated MLOps promotion workflows (from SageMaker Canvas/Sandbox to production).
  • Integrate data de-identification, Format Preserving Encryption (FPE), and tokenization wrappers into ML data pipelines to ensure zero raw PII enters AWS cloud environments during model training and inference.
  • Set up telemetry, performance monitoring, model drift detection, and cost anomaly alerting for AI/ML workloads using Amazon CloudWatch, Splunk, and FinOps spend control frameworks.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering, AI Architects, and Cloud Teams to integrate vector storage/retrieval (RAG), Apache Spark/EMR-on-EKS runtimes, and local tokenization databases.
  • Author technical MLOps runbooks, model deployment procedures, governance documentation, and disaster recovery playbooks.

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in MLOps, DataOps, or Platform Engineering with a primary focus on enterprise Amazon SageMaker (Pipelines, Feature Store, Model Registry, Endpoints).
  • Proven experience deploying and operating Generative AI, LLM/SLM models, and Amazon Bedrock services alongside agentic frameworks and RAG pipelines.
  • Hands-on expertise with MLflow for experiment tracking, model registry, and lifecycle management.
  • Solid experience in GPU optimization and orchestration (NVIDIA A100/L40S, AWS EC2 GPU instances) for model training, fine-tuning, and low-latency real-time inference (STT/TTS voice pipelines).
  • Proficient in building CI/CD for Machine Learning (GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or AWS CDK).
  • Practical knowledge of LLMOps / AgentOps tools and methodologies (AgentCore, prompt evaluations, Bedrock Guardrails, vector databases for RAG).
  • Strong understanding of data security, privacy, and tokenization (FPE, handling sensitive/PII data within ML pipelines).
  • Proficient in Python, PySpark, Docker, and Kubernetes/EKS fundamentals for containerized ML workloads.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty certification.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional.
  • Experience in telecom domain AI/ML applications, low-latency real-time voice/chat processing (ASR/TTS), or hybrid cloud data sovereignty architectures.
  • Experience with EMR-on-EKS, Starburst/Athena, or Apache Iceberg data lake integrations.

Soft Skills & Team Fit:

  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work closely with cross-functional teams (Data Engineering, AI/GenAI Engineers, Security, Cloud/Infrastructure).
  • Results-oriented, proactive mindset with strong ownership of deliverables within an Agile / Scrum framework.
  • Upper-Intermediate+ English level (written and spoken).

What we propose:

  • Opportunity to lead critical, high-impact Data & AI platform delivery for a major telecommunications operator.
  • Hands-on work with modern MLOps and GenAI stack (Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, MLflow, AgentCore, STT/TTS voicebot pipelines).
  • Flexible remote work options with structured, predictable collaboration within a well-balanced team.

We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)

You will lead and develop a high-performing product organization while partnering closely with the CPO and senior company leadership.

You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Data/AI, Clinical, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations to build intelligent, scalable solutions that transform population health workflows and improve healthcare outcomes.

What you will do

Our Mission:

Our Children's Trust is a non-profit public interest law firm that provides strategic, campaign-based legal services to youth from diverse backgrounds to secure their legal rights to a safe climate. We work to protect the Earth's climate system for present and future generations by representing young people in global legal efforts to secure their binding and enforceable legal rights to a healthy atmosphere and stable climate based on the best available science. We support our youth clients and amplify their voices before the third branch of government in a highly strategic legal campaign that includes targeted media, education, and public engagement to support the youths' legal actions. Our legal work – guided by constitutional, public trust, human rights laws, and the laws of nature – aims to ensure systemic and science-based climate recovery planning and remedies at federal, state, and global levels. We seek legally-binding, countrywide and/or statewide science-based Climate Recovery Plans that will return atmospheric carbon dioxide concentrations to levels below 350 ppm by the year 2100.

Position Summary:

This is a voluntary, unpaid internship that will provide general support for OCT's strategic work in Washington, DC. There may be opportunities to work on Capitol Hill if you are located near or visiting DC.

Government affairs interns will directly support OCT's legal efforts in federal actions, including the constitutional and public trust climate cases filed against the federal government: Lighthiser v. Trump. and Venner v. EPA. Interns will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects and potentially other cases. OCT relies heavily on interns for support, placing a premium on careful, accurate, and self-directed work. We are seeking experienced interns with excellent research, writing, and communication skills, and who are responsive, work independently, take initiative, are flexible and think creatively to find solutions. You will lead a team of analysts responsible for understanding audience trends, driving product improvement, and optimizing user engagement.   • You will demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to shape the architecture and expansion strategy for our data center metro networks. This highly visible, internal-facing role combines product leadership, technical diligence, and program execution to ensure network investments deliver meaningful business value.

You will own the roadmap for internal network products that enable external services, evaluate whether proposed expansion efforts offer the right technical solution and expected return, and lead cross-functional teams through delivery. Success requires deep metro network expertise, strong financial and analytical judgment, and the ability to turn complex technical decisions into clear, actionable recommendations.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy, requirements, and multi-year architectural roadmap for data center metro network solutions and expansion programs.
  • Translate topology, diversity, capacity, transport, optical-layer, and point-of-presence decisions into repeatable configurations and reference designs.
  • Lead cross-functional expansion programs from evaluation through delivery, coordinating teams, dependencies, milestones, risks, and executive status reporting.
  • Evaluate proposed network investments using demand, utilization, capital efficiency, revenue potential, and return-on-investment analysis.
  • Establish a consistent framework for prioritizing, approving, deferring, or redesigning metro network upgrades and expansion efforts.
  • Build demand models that combine contracted demand, pipeline, market signals, customer architecture plans, and forecast scenarios.
  • Assess whether existing internal products and architectural solutions remain the right platforms for future growth, including lower-cost alternatives and associated trade-offs.
  • Partner with Product, Network Planning, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Service Delivery, and Sales to drive decisions and execution.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 8-10+ years of experience in product management, program management, network planning, or network engineering.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting metro, data center, optical, packet transport, or related network infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of metro network architecture, including ring and mesh topologies, route and fiber diversity, point-of-presence and colocation siting, and protection and restoration strategies.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs through planning, decision-making, and delivery.
  • Ability to build and defend quantitative demand, investment, and return-on-investment models using incomplete or evolving data.
  • Understanding of capital economics, including capital and operating expense trade-offs, payback, internal rate of return, utilization, and unit cost.
  • Experience translating complex technical and financial analysis into concise, decision-ready recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Ability to influence across Product, Engineering, Planning, Finance, Operations, and Sales in a matrixed environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with metro fiber, conduit builds, data center expansion programs, or carrier network infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with hyperscaler, neocloud, cloud, or AI infrastructure demand patterns.
  • Experience evaluating internal network platforms that support the development and delivery of external services.
  • Advanced modeling experience in Excel and experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, or another analytical or visualization environment.
  • Knowledge of reliability engineering, availability targets, failure-mode analysis, and service-level design requirements.
  • Experience developing product roadmaps, reference architectures, lifecycle policies, and investment prioritization frameworks.
  • MBA, engineering degree, or an equivalent combination of technical and commercial experience.

Responsibilities

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected.

We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission — you’ll define it.

Peraton is seeking talented self-starting Surveillance Radar Advisor with experience in radar systems (operator or technician) to support the modernization and sustainment of the National Airspace System (NAS) and FAA surveillance systems. In this role, you will analyze, advise, and report key performance information in order to implement upgrades to the current ATC system that are critical to safe and efficient air travel. By supporting the implementation and modernization of short-to-medium range radar systems, you will directly contribute to the future of U.S. aviation infrastructure.

This is a unique opportunity to apply your radar knowledge to mission-critical programs that ensure the safety, security, and reliability of the nation’s airspace.

This position is 100% remote with about 75% travel.

Responsibilities:

  • Be capable of providing subject matter expertise on radar system integration, operations, and lifecycle sustainment.
  • Support FAA surveillance programs with performance analysis, troubleshooting, and modernization planning.
  • Observe, capture and report technical data pertinent to the installation and modernization of FAA radar systems.
  • Collaborate with FAA stakeholders, contractors, and engineering teams to align with mission objectives.
  • Develop and submit concise technical reports and status reports throughout each phase of the project (site survey, pre-install & parts - received at site, installation, and finally, testing and acceptance).
  • Provide immediate notification to higher Peraton authority of significant concerns (Risk, Issues, Opportunity) along with their potential impacts to the schedule.
  • Oversees site and vendor technicians, have situational awareness of past and upcoming equipment installation schedules, and ensure compliance with FAA mandates.
  • Upon completion of installation and acceptance tests, continue to monitor updated systems and communicate with site technicians and vendors to ensure optimization of all ATC systems through calibrations, alignments, and additional testing required. All efforts result in updated radar systems that provide optimal detection capabilities and increased data accuracy.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • US citizenship with the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • 8 years with BS/BA; 6 years with MS/MA; 12 years with no degree.
  • Proven strong self-starter traits.
  • Must have significant hands on technical work such as maintenance on any moderately complex system such as radars, radios or networks.
  • Capable of implementing the steps to conflict resolution and deconfliction.
  • Capable of independent operation under agile conditions with limited oversite and/or managerial control.
  • Capable of critical thinking, following processes and procedures.
  • Travel 75% (expected travel is 1 month on and 2 weeks remote rotation).
  • Solid communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Capable of assessing a large amount of pertinent data and producing detailed technical reports at a consumable level under time limitations.
  • Provide clear and effective communications to all parties.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarization of radar operations, ATC systems & operations, and/or Integrated Air and Missile Defense systems.
  • Expert use of Microsoft products and business applications.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

raw.description:
Founded in 1936, the National Wildlife Federation has grown into America's largest and most trusted grassroots conservation organization with 52 state and territorial affiliates and more than seven million members and supporters, including hunters, anglers, gardeners, birders, hikers, campers, paddlers, and outdoor enthusiasts of all ages and stripes. The mission of the National Wildlife Federation is to unite all Americans to ensure wildlife thrive in our rapidly changing world. We advance this mission through programming focused on conserving wildlife, restoring habitats and waterways, expanding outdoor opportunities, connecting children with nature, advancing environmental justice, and addressing the causes and consequences of climate change.

The Operations Manager position is part of NWF’s Program Operations team and focuses on business optimization. The Operations Manager will work with stakeholders across the organization to help NWF achieve operational excellence. On any given day, that might consist of writing a guidance document, mapping a process, analyzing data to understand impact or pain points, and strategizing to help leadership make decisions.

The ideal candidate will be curious about how things work, passionate about making things better, and practiced at bringing people together and moving them to action. This position calls for someone who is fearless in carving their own path when the project is ambiguous and who will know how to create clarity for others.

This position is matrixed, reporting directly to the Senior Director of Program Operations and working collaboratively to support program leaders. This position will also work closely with other support departments of the organization including (but not limited to) Finance, Philanthropy, Legal, Human Resources, and Accounts Payable.

Key Responsibilities

Data and Evaluation

  • Work with program and advocacy teams to develop operational performance metrics
  • Help program and advocacy teams visualize data to identify where budgets face risks or opportunities with resources
  • Analyze data and provide insights to help leaders make strategic operational decisions
  • Report on program operational health and performance to leadership
  • Administer current Airtable bases, ensure good data hygiene, and act as training resource on bases

Process and System Improvement

  • Collaborate with various teams to map processes and pinch points
  • Work collaboratively to suggest process improvements and project-manage implementation as required

Best Practices & Training

  • Document best practices and create process documentation and standard operating procedures
  • Develop onboarding documentation for Program Operations - standardized templates and workflows
  • Train program operations leaders on new processes and systems as needed
  • Train new Program Ops staff in tandem with their managers

General Program Operational Support

  • Lead teams to solve complex and/or urgent operational issues
  • Provide surge support when program operations teams need assistance with budget and grant management
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience in a relevant field (e.g., business administration, finance, )
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in financial management, operations, or administration capacity, preferably in a nonprofit setting. Federal grant management is a plus.
  • 2+ years of experience influencing others (either with direct or indirect authority) to achieve a shared goal
  • Comfort with adapting to changing priorities and learning new processes and software
  • Demonstrated strong project management skills while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams, preferably in operations
  • Ability to analyze datasets, synthesize data, and present findings to leaders
  • Communicate clearly and distill complex technical concepts into layperson language
  • Experience with soliciting information from teams while minimizing burden
  • Reputation as a changemaker with a positive, solutions-oriented attitude
  • Demonstrate skill in collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to support project outcomes
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office products including MS Word, PowerPoint, and Exhibit advanced skills in Excel functions such as writing formulas and data manipulation. Ability and experience working with Smartsheet, Airtable, or other project management tools
NWF Values

Your actions are expected to reflect the staff values of the National Wildlife Federation: collaboration, mindfulness, empowerment, inclusivity, and mission focus. Your competencies should include:

  • Being motivated by values of equity and responsibility to those most marginalized
  • Consistently bringing a high level of empathy and social skills to work and interpersonal interactions
  • Being committed to deepening an environmental justice approach in policy priorities, program development and partner engagement
  • Actively seeks feedback, direction, and guidance from all team members and keeps staff informed of decisions that impact them
  • Being dedicated to advancing NWF’s internal equity transformation and compelling partners and allies to incorporate equity into their work
  • Passion for and commitment to NWF's mission
Travel Requirements

Approximately 1-2 times per year; 2-4 nights per trip.

Location and Work Mode

The National Wildlife Federation is committed to a flexible and empowered work environment with an authentic community of care for all staff. This position will work remotely, although some travel throughout the year is expected.

Physical Requirements:

Cognitive & Intellectual Requirements

  • Ability to understand, analyze, and apply complex information, policies, and concepts
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, problem-solve, and make decisions in situations involving ambiguity or competing priorities
  • Ability to maintain focus and sustained attention and manage multiple tasks or work-streams
  • Ability to listen, interpret, and respond appropriately in discussions with colleagues, leadership, and external stakeholders
  • Physical Requirements
  • Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time while working at a computer or attending meetings
  • Ability to operate standard office equipment, including computers, keyboards, monitors, telephones, and video conferencing tools
  • Ability to communicate and exchange information in person, via telephone, and through electronic or virtual platforms
  • Ability to read, review, and produce written and electronic documents, including prolonged use of computer screens
  • Ability to move within an office or remote work environment to access files, meetings, or equipment as needed

Work Environment

  • Work is performed primarily in an office or remote environment
  • Role may involve extended screen time and participation in virtual meetings

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $72,000 - $80,000, commensurate with experience.

We are proud of our designation by Mogul as a Top 100 Workplace with the Best Benefits, and by Forbes as one of America’s best small employers! We value work-life balance and a family-friendly atmosphere with flexible scheduling. We want you to be able to integrate work and personal life with attention to your self-care, so that your work schedule is not depleting. We offer benefits so you feel restored and fueled through the day and week.

We offer these supports to help manage your mental, emotional, and physical health:

  • Paid time off: Vacation that starts off at three weeks accrual based on a full-time schedule, unlimited wellbeing (this time can be used for physical, spiritual, emotional, cultural, religious or financial wellbeing for yourself, a partner, or family member – including pets), and 11 holidays
  • We close down for a paid winter break between December 25 to January 1 to recognize end of-year stress, and time for reflection, rejuvenation, and spending time with family.
  • Up to 16 weeks of fully paid Family and Medical Leave
  • Low-cost health, dental, and vision insurance options – all outpatient mental health is covered at in-network rates
  • Therapist available at no cost
  • Pet insurance and discount perk program
  • Annual wellbeing allowance

In addition to your salary, we offer the following supports to your personal finances:

  • Retirement plan with immediate match and vesting
  • Annual year end retirement contribution
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Adoption and Surrogacy assistance
  • Pet adoption stipend

raw.excerpt: About Sundays for Dogs Sundays for Dogs is a founder-led brand reimagining pet food so dog owners can spend more quality time with their dogs—now and later.
raw.description:
About Sundays for Dogs

Sundays for Dogs is a founder-led brand reimagining pet food so dog owners can spend more quality time with their dogs—now and later. We make human-grade, air-dried food that supports long, healthy lives, and we're building a company that reflects how great teams should work: with low ego, high ownership, honest feedback, creative problem-solving, and a bias toward doing more with less.

Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, we're a distributed team of 60 full-time employees across the U.S. While we work remotely day-to-day, we gather quarterly in person because relationships matter. Our subscription-based DTC model is our foundation. We're entering an exciting growth stage—expanding our product assortment, driving innovation, and thoughtfully opening new channels. We're building to scale with intention, and we're just getting started.

About your team and position:

The Marketing team at Sundays blends artistic vision with strategic thinking to craft everything customers see. But this role isn't about one point of view — it's about building a system that produces hundreds of ideas at once and letting the data decide which ones win.

The Director of Performance Creative is a brand new role — the first of its kind at Sundays — built around three numbers: ad volume (scaling from roughly 20 to 1,000 net-new ads a month), ad quality (hook rate, CAC, and performance), and diversity (of format, source, and audience cohort). Reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing and sitting as a peer to the Director of Growth and the Creative Director, you'll act as executive producer for Sundays' creative engine: building the system, deciding which of the hundreds of incoming creatives earn a spot in Meta, and using performance data — not personal taste alone — to call winners and losers.

Your task is to build an engine that sources creative and concepts from multiple outlets — in-house strategists, influencers, and outside agencies — because getting real diversity of output requires real diversity of sources. Under you sits a team of full-stack creative strategists (each owns concept, shoot, and edit for their own ads) and a TikTok team building toward a large-scale ambassador network. If you love building systems, love data, and want to prove that volume and craft aren't opposites, this role was built for you.

Your day-to-day:

  • Own the quarter's two most important numbers: ad volume and ad quality — plus diversity of format, source, and cohort.
  • Act as executive producer: review the flow of incoming creative from strategists, influencers, and agencies, and decide what gets uploaded to Meta.
  • Use performance data to separate winners from losers, and feed those learnings back into the system in real time.
  • Hire and lead a team of full-stack creative strategists — each concepting, shooting, and editing their own ads.
  • Build out a dedicated editing bench so editing never becomes the bottleneck on output.
  • Launch and grow the TikTok Ambassador Program by year-end, including hiring a dedicated TikTok manager.
  • Manage relationships with outside creative and influencer agencies as a bridge while the owned creator network scales — with the long-term goal of owning the network, not renting it.

What Success Looks Like:

  • First 3 months: First full-stack creative strategists hired; volume, quality, and diversity scorecard in place; monthly ad output quickly climbing from baseline.
  • Month 6: Dedicated TikTok manager and editing bench in place; TikTok Ambassador Program underway; monthly ad output scaling into the hundreds.
  • Month 9: Full-stack strategist team at capacity across Cleveland, LA, and Austin; output approaching 1,000 net-new ads a month with clear CAC and hook rate reporting.
  • Month 12: TikTok Ambassador Program at or near 2,000 creators; a decentralized creative system running smoothly across in-house strategists, influencers, and agency partners.

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 8+ years in high-volume creative production, performance creative, or content operations — bonus points if you've done it in DTC or subscription.
  • Experience running a decentralized creative model: sourcing and managing output from multiple creators, freelancers, or agencies at once, rather than directing a single creative point of view.
  • A track record of building and scaling high-throughput creative teams — ideally people who can concept, shoot, and edit their own work.
  • Real fluency with performance data (hook rate, CAC, ad performance) and the ability to use it, not just gut instinct, to decide what gets made and what gets cut.
  • Experience with TikTok creator or ambassador programs, and an understanding of what it takes to build an owned creator network rather than rent one through an agency.
  • Comfort managing outside agency relationships as part of a broader in-house strategy.
  • A genuine appetite for volume — this role is about generating hundreds of assets and letting data decide, not producing a handful of hero campaigns.

This role is critical in ensuring patients receive timely communication, appointments are managed efficiently, and administrative workflows run smoothly.

As the primary point of contact, you will handle inbound and outbound calls, appointment scheduling, and patient follow-ups, helping patients stay informed, prepared, and engaged throughout their care journey. raw.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Tenstorrent is hiring full time and contract recruiters. We're looking for people who own searches rather than fill them. You would carry a portfolio spanning hardware, AI software and go-to-market, and own each search from the hiring manager intake through the accepted offer: the spec, the level call, the market read, what the loop tests, and the close. When you think the bar is wrong, you'll have direct influence with the hiring team to make a change.

This is a generalist seat. In a given quarter you might be hiring silicon design and verification, compiler and ML framework engineers, and a go-to-market leader. Deep expertise in all three is not the expectation and nobody here has it. What the role requires is getting to a defensible read in territory you do not know: what to ask, whose judgment to borrow, and what you will not conclude on your own.

This role is remote, with global opportunities.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

  • You form your own view of a candidate. You read what someone actually built, shipped, taped out or carried, and you can say which parts of a profile are outside your judgment and how you would get to an answer.
  • You would rather give a hiring manager unwelcome news early than manage around it. You have changed someone's mind about a bar using evidence, without any authority over the decision.
  • You are comfortable being the least domain-expert person in the room and still producing a read people can act on.
  • You build the mechanism. When a loop is not working, you fix what it tests rather than only how it runs.

What We Need

  • You have owned searches end to end, from intake to accepted offer, in more than one domain. Technical and go-to-market both count. We care about the range, not the logo.
  • You have closed senior candidates who held a better-paying offer, and you can say what they wanted that was not money.
  • You can turn a vague hiring manager need into a written spec with a level call and a stated trade, and you re-open the must-haves when the level or the budget moves instead of quietly lowering the target.
  • You watch a small number of numbers on your own searches, and you have changed course because of one.

What You Will Learn

  • How a hardware company that actually ships makes hiring decisions, from silicon through go-to-market.
  • How to read primary evidence about deeply technical people: what a tapeout history, a repository or a paper actually tells you about depth.
  • How to design an interview loop and a scorecard a busy panel will hold to, and run a debrief that can decide.
  • How to build recruiting process while the systems around it are still being rebuilt, which is a different skill from operating a finished one.

Compensation for this role ranges from $100,000 to $177,000 base, plus equity and a bonus target. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology. Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2). These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S. As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency. If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

raw.description:
Overview

As part of Lynker's ongoing growth and expansion, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Evaluations Specialist to join our growing team.

This position will support programmatic evaluations of Coastal Zone Management (CZM) programs and National Estuarine Research Reserves (NERRs), as required by section 312 of the Coastal Zone Management Act. The Coastal Zone Management Act of 1972, as amended, requires NOAA to conduct periodic evaluations of the performance of states and territories with federally approved coastal management programs or estuarine reserves. Each evaluation reviews implementation of the approved coastal management program or reserve management plan; coastal management requirements; completion of the terms of financial assistance awards. This contract position would organize the necessary information to guide development of the draft findings to be delivered by the federal evaluator and support other statutory and regulatory analyses related to the CZMA evaluation program.

Each year, NOAA’s Office for Coastal Management identifies the suite of CZM programs and reserves to be evaluated the following year. Programs are notified and paired with an evaluator to identify the schedule for the evaluation and site visit and to submit information that can be used in the evaluation to document program strengths and challenges and to provide recommendations for how to address potential challenges. Each evaluation is assigned a lead evaluator to work with a team of staff that is knowledgeable about the program itself, the local community and associated partnerships, and the national program. The evaluation team solicits feedback from local partners and stakeholders and identifies the primary areas of interest for a virtual or in-person site visit to gather additional input to guide the draft findings regarding program accomplishments, recommendations for enhancements, and necessary actions to address deficiencies.

Responsibilities

Duties of the Evaluation Specialist will include the following:

  • Serve as an evaluator to support program evaluations under CZMA section 312
  • Organize information from program submittals, stakeholder survey, and progress reports to guide primary focus areas for the retreat
  • Plan and organize meetings with the programs being evaluated to explain the process, schedule the evaluation, and advance progress toward the evaluation
  • Conduct the virtual, in-person, or hybrid site visit to meet with program leadership, staff, and partners or stakeholders to gather additional input regarding accomplishments and challenges
  • Draft initial findings to include program accomplishments, recommendations, and necessary actions to address challenges
  • Finalize the findings and share with the program and its leadership
  • Support statutory and regulatory analyses related to the CZMA evaluation program

Qualifications

The Evaluation Specialist selected should have the following:

  • Master’s degree
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Highly motivated, self-starter with the ability to work in a small team environment without direct day-to-day supervision
  • Ability to write, edit, and analyze information
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Possess strong written and oral communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to prioritize multiple concurrent tasks
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships with management, colleagues, and external partners
  • Ability to pass a National Agency Check and fingerprinting background check and maintain it through the duration of employment

About Lynker

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. Our continually expanding team combines scientific expertise with mature, results-driven processes and tools to achieve technically sound, cost effective solutions in hydrology/water sciences, geospatial analysis, information technology, resource management, conservation, and management and business process improvement.

We focus on putting the right people in the right place to be effective. And having the right people is critical for success. Our streamlined organization enables and empowers our talented professionals to tackle our customers' scientific and technical priorities – creatively and effectively.

Lynker offers a team-oriented work environment, and the opportunity to work in a culture of exceptionally skilled professionals who embrace sound science and creative solutions. Lynker's benefits include the following:

  • Comprehensive healthcare for the employee at no monthly cost
  • Healthcare benefit covers medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision
  • Personal Time Off (PTO) Policy plus paid holidays
  • Highly competitive compensation plan regularly calibrated against industry and location benchmarks
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company-matching
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) – we're all company owners!

  • Tuition assistance/Training/Workforce improvement reimbursement per year
  • Spot bonuses for exceptional performance

  • Free centralized, self-directed Learning Management System to learn at your own pace
  • Personalized career growth plans for every employee

Lynker is an E-Verify employer.

We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

  • Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.
  • Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.

  • Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.
  • Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.
  • Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.
  • Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.
  • Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.

  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

We are now hiring a SOC Deployment Engineer to join our Security Operations Centre (SOC) and support the delivery of our managed security services. This role will focus on the deployment, configuration and optimisation of security tooling, helping ensure customer environments are onboarded effectively and monitored securely.

Working closely with SOC Analysts, Engineers and customers, you will support the implementation of SIEM and SOAR technologies, maintain SOC infrastructure and contribute to the ongoing improvement of our security operations capabilities.

What will you be doing?

  • Design, deploy and support SIEM solutions to meet customer security requirements.
  • Work with customers and internal stakeholders to gather requirements and support onboarding activities.
  • Configure and fine-tune SIEM platforms to optimise performance, visibility and detection capability.
  • Support the development and deployment of SOAR playbooks to streamline incident response processes.
  • Maintain the availability and performance of SOC infrastructure, including servers, networks and security appliances.
  • Configure and optimise log ingestion pipelines and security tool integrations.
  • Manage SOC ticket queues and ensure service-level agreements are achieved.
  • Ensure incidents are accurately logged, tracked and documented.
  • Support the ongoing development and improvement of managed security services.
  • Collaborate with analysts, engineers and service teams to improve operational effectiveness.
  • Contribute to security tooling enhancements, process improvements and operational standards.

What are we looking for?

  • Experience designing, deploying and supporting SIEM solutions, ideally Microsoft Sentinel.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Good understanding of SOC operations and managed security services.
  • Knowledge of security technologies, threat detection and security monitoring.
  • Strong understanding of networking and communication protocols including HTTP, DNS and TCP/UDP.
  • Understanding of malware techniques, persistence mechanisms and threat actor behaviours.
  • Experience with scripting or automation languages such as PowerShell, Python, Bash or similar.
  • Experience working with virtualisation technologies such as VMware.
  • Understanding of cloud environments including Azure and AWS.
  • Knowledge of security domains such as identity and access management, web security, intrusion detection and cloud security.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience working within a SOC, cyber security or security engineering environment.
  • Experience deploying and supporting SIEM technologies.
  • Experience supporting enterprise security tooling and infrastructure.
  • Experience working with security automation technologies beneficial.
  • Relevant Microsoft, cyber security or infrastructure certifications desirable.

Practical stuff

Where is the role based?
This role can be fully remote within the UK, with quarterly visits to our HQ in Pocklington (YO42).

How many interviews?
Following a screen with the Recruitment Team, you can expect a two-stage interview process.

Important Security Clearance

Due to the nature of our customer base and managed security services, SC clearance is required for this role. Candidates must either already hold active SC clearance or be eligible and willing to obtain and maintain it.

To obtain SC clearance, candidates will normally need to have lived continuously in the UK for at least five years and satisfy the relevant security vetting requirements.

Important BPSS Check

As part of our recruitment process and due to the nature of the work we do, all employees are required to undertake a BPSS check. While some employees may require further security clearance, the BPSS check is mandatory and all offers of employment are conditional upon successful completion.

Have you made it this far?

If you're still reading, we think there's a strong chance you might be our kind of person.

Here's the thing, research suggests many women and underrepresented groups don't apply unless they meet every requirement. Even if you don't tick every box above, we encourage you to introduce yourself.

We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger, and the stronger our team, the more successful we will be.
