Overview

Essen Health Care is the largest privately held, multispecialty medical group in New York, providing high-quality, compassionate care to some of the state’s most vulnerable and underserved residents.

Founded in 1999, we’ve grown from a single primary care office into a network of 50+ locations offering urgent care, primary care and specialty services, from women’s health to endocrinology and psychiatry. We also provide nursing home support, care management, and in-home care through our Essen House Calls program. Guided by a Population Health model, our team of 500+ providers deliver care in-person, at home, or via telehealth, ensuring patients get the support they need when and where they need it.

We’re looking for talented, motivated individuals to join our growing team. Whether you’re a medical provider, administrator, or operations professional, there’s a career here for you. Join us in making a real difference in the health of our community.

Job Summary

Medicare funds a concierge program for the highest-needs patients, in return for provably improving healthcare outcomes and reducing hospitalizations. The role of the Inside Sales Specialist is to educate patients about this program, about how this program can help them, and to assist them in enrolling in this program. You’ll receive lists of patients identified as eligible about the program, outreach them, and gather consents. We are looking for someone with sales experience, who understands how to do a consultative sale, how to make the patient feel empowered throughout the discussion, rather than pitched at, and who can be self-organized to outreach to, and follow-up with, their contacted patients as needed and deliver against a target enrollment rate.

Responsibilities

  • Learn the details of the program and the context in which it is offered so that you can help patients and their families to understand the value it will bring to their lives. Some understanding of the health care industry and terminology (not clinical) is required.
  • Call, or otherwise outreach, patients constantly throughout the day, bringing a positive energy and enthusiasm to each call.
  • Keep track of patients outreached in such a way that you can complete additional follow-up and follow-through using excel-based tracking sheets.
  • Consult the patient’s Electronic Health Record prior to each call in order to understand a little about where the patient is in their healthcare journey, so you can better tailor the conversation to their needs.
  • Suggest improvements to how you might approach the call and discussion of the program based on how patients respond to your conversation.
  • Surface patient needs and work with Care Management team to address those needs in real time to “show, not tell” the value of the services we provide.
  • Assist elderly and otherwise not highly technological patients and family members with completing an e-Consent form for enrollment in the program.
  • Ensure timely and accurate completion of forms and submissions for patients wishing to enroll.
  • Understand compliance issues related to how the program is discussed and pitched, and ensure your organic patient conversations remain within the “rules of the road.”
  • Support audits and regulatory reviews by maintaining proper documentation and compliance standards.

Qualifications

  • Associates degree, Bachelor's degree, or above
  • Some amount of experience in health care or social work

· 2-3 years experience in sales

  • Ability to function in a fast-paced environment, to be held accountable for high performance standards, and to deliver against targets and KPIs?
  • Familiarity with Electronic Health Records (EHR) and health insurance terminology

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong communication and public speaking skills
  • High EQ and excellent active listening skills

· Excellent sales or persuasion skills

  • Cultural sensitivity and ability to work with diverse, underserved populations
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including ability to use filters and conditional formatting to manage your own workflows and follow-up.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay: $25/hr base, some OT available, performance-based bonuses up to 40% of base wages

· Job Type: Full-time

Equal Opportunity Employer

Essen Health care is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we seek candidates who desire to work in and serve an ethnically diverse population.

Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success.

We're building a different kind of system, in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today.

What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along.

About the roleWe're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our BNPL stream and design the merchant side of Tabby's core product. You'll work on the Merchant Dashboard, across web and the mobile app, the place where merchants run their business with Tabby: manage transactions, settlements and invoices, set up in-store and integrations, and use self-service tools.

You'll join a newly formed Merchant Experience team with a lot of attention on it and a lot to build: upgrading core dashboard pages, launching new self-service products, running merchant experiments, and rethinking how Tabby works in physical stores.

We're looking for someone who thrives on complexity, turns uncertainty into clarity, owns problems end to end, and brings strong product thinking alongside strong craft.

Why join
  • Work on the merchant side of Tabby's core BNPL product, in an area that is a current company priority
  • A lot to build: core page upgrades, new self-service products, experiments and a rethought in-store experience
  • Real ownership in a newly formed team: shape how the product and the team work from the start
  • An AI-forward team where design can iterate fast and get close to code
  • A dedicated UX writer and UX researcher to work with

What you will be doing

  • Own merchant journeys in the Merchant Dashboard end to end, across web and mobile, from early concept through polished execution
  • Upgrade core dashboard pages such as transactions, settlements and invoices, and design new self-service tools for merchants
  • Design clear, data-dense interfaces that make complex financial and operational information easy to understand and act on
  • Design and iterate on merchant experiments and new features with your Product Manager, and measure what works
  • Help reimagine the in-store experience together with product and engineering
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers and our UX researcher and UX writer to identify and solve key merchant problems
  • Use data, merchant feedback and research insights to inform design decisions and validate hypotheses
  • Partner with designers from other B2B and B2C streams to keep the experience consistent across Tabby, and contribute to the design system
  • Use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow: prototyping, ideation, and moving solutions closer to code
  • Present and advocate for your work to cross-functional and senior stakeholders, ensuring clarity and alignment

What you will need

  • Proven experience designing digital products, ideally B2B, fintech, or complex data-rich tools
  • Strong craft skills demonstrated through a portfolio, with excellent Figma skills
  • Comfort designing across both web/dashboard and native mobile (iOS and Android)
  • Strong product thinking: you understand business goals, product logic and user needs, and can explain the reasoning behind your decisions
  • Ability to turn uncertainty into clarity and handle complex flows, states and edge cases
  • A strong level of AI proficiency: you use AI tools on real project work to prototype, explore and move faster
  • Understanding of technical constraints and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering
  • Confident in your work and strong communication skills, whether you're talking to another designer or a C-level executive
  • Experience applying systems thinking and contributing to shared design systems
  • Autonomy: you operate without close supervision and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluency in English
Nice to have
  • Experience in fintech or financial products
  • Experience conducting UX research
  • A strong base in graphic design
  • Experience designing for GCC markets or Arabic/RTL interfaces
  • Comfort working close to code, with interest in contributing to code through AI tools

Benefits

Locations

We hire candidates based within four hours of Dubai time, with remote work available in eligible locations. Depending on your circumstances, we can also discuss an individual relocation plan to our hubs in Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Poland, and Spain.

What you can expect
  • Flexible working hours, coordinated with your team and the needs of your role.
  • Autonomy and responsibility from day one.
  • Opportunities to grow through the quality and impact of your work.
  • Participation in our employee stock option program.
We’re committed to an inclusive, high-performing workplace where people from different backgrounds have the support to grow and achieve their goals.
If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we’d love to hear from you.

raw.excerpt: You've found us at a good time.  Hapana is opening new markets, shipping new products and welcoming new brands onto the platform we're looking for the people who'll grow with us.
raw.description:
You've found us at a good time. Hapana is opening new markets, shipping new products and welcoming new brands onto the platform we're looking for the people who'll grow with us. This could be one of those right-place, right-time moments. Here's everything you need to know.

WHO WE ARE

Hapana powers the world's best fitness brands. Walk into a Fitstop, KX, Gold's Gym or J.I.M and there's a good chance our platform is running the whole show: memberships, bookings, marketing, payments, growth.

The fitness industry is booming, and we're the technology underneath it. We're 110 people across Australia, USA, UK, Brazil, Singapore and India and the work we ship reaches studios and members all over the world. Build something here and you'll see it land in the product, in our clients' businesses and in the team around you.

WHERE YOU COME IN

You'll be the People & Culture partner for our USA, Brazil & UK team and the right hand to our Director of People & Culture when it comes to supporting and growing our USA, Brazil and UK business.

You'll own the People experience on the ground, partnering closely with leaders to build high-performing teams, navigate the moments that matter, and make sure our People practices keep pace with the business as we grow.

This isn't a role where you'll sit on the sidelines and hand managers a policy. You'll coach leaders through performance conversations, handle complex employee matters, improve the way we work, spot risks before they become problems, and help build the People foundations we need for our next stage of growth.

It's a role for someone who likes having real ownership, can move comfortably between strategy and execution, and knows that great People & Culture is equal parts commercial judgement, strong relationships and getting things done.

WHAT YOU'D BE DOING

Be the primary People & Culture partner for our USA, Brazil and UK teams, building trusted relationships with leaders and employees and providing practical, commercially minded People advice.

  • Partner closely with the Director of People & Culture and leadership across the USA, Brazil and UK to drive performance, organisational priorities, employee development, engagement and team effectiveness.
  • Coach and support managers through complex People matters, including performance concerns, Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), difficult conversations, employee relations, investigations and organisational change.
  • Own the employee lifecycle across the USA, Brazil and UK, from onboarding and development through to employment changes and offboarding, partnering with our People & Culture Generalist to deliver a consistent and seamless employee experience.
  • Lead employee relations matters across the USA, Brazil and UK with confidence and sound judgement, ensuring strong documentation, consistent processes and appropriate escalation to external employment advisors when specialist guidance is required.
  • Drive performance review cycles and support managers to turn performance conversations into clear expectations, actions and meaningful development plans.
  • Maintain compliant and scalable People practices across the USA, Brazil and UK, staying current with relevant employment requirements and ensuring our policies, processes and documentation evolve as the business grows.
  • Build and continuously improve People processes, playbooks and frameworks that give managers clarity, improve the employee experience and keep unnecessary complexity to a minimum.
  • Use People data, employee feedback and business insights to identify trends, risks and opportunities early and translate them into practical actions.
  • Champion the employee experience through benefits, wellbeing, recognition, engagement and initiatives that bring Hapana’s culture and values to life.
  • Partner with hiring managers and the broader People team on recruitment as required, helping us attract great people and deliver an exceptional candidate experience.
  • Support workforce planning, organisational design and capability planning as our USA, Brazil and UK teams continue to scale.
  • Partner cross-functionally on projects and initiatives where People, workplace and business operations intersect.
  • Own and champion our USA Health, Dental and Vision benefits, ensuring employees understand and get the most from their benefits while supporting effective administration and ongoing improvement of our offering.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 4–6+ years of experience in People & Culture / HR, with strong experience across both People Operations and HR Business Partnering.
  • Strong working knowledge of USA employment law and HR best practice, ideally with experience supporting employees across multiple states.
  • Confidence independently managing employee relations, performance management, Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), investigations and other sensitive or complex People matters.
  • Experience partnering directly with senior leaders and managers, with the confidence to coach, influence and respectfully challenge when needed.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to balance the needs of our people with the needs of the business.
  • Experience building, improving and scaling People processes in a growing organisation, ideally within SaaS, technology or another fast-paced environment.
  • The ability to think strategically while remaining comfortable getting hands-on and making things happen.
  • Experience supporting distributed or global teams, particularly across the USA, Brazil and UK, would be highly regarded.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You build trust by being clear, thoughtful and consistent.
  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and follow through on commitments.
  • Experience with TriNet and payroll administration would be highly regarded.
  • Confidence working with HR systems such as BambooHR or similar, alongside People data and modern workplace tools.
  • A relevant qualification in HR, Business or a related field is valued, but we place just as much importance on practical experience and what you can bring to the role.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

We're clear about what great looks like from day one, so you can aim at it from day one. In your first year:

  • Our leaders see you as a trusted People partner and bring you into conversations early, not after a problem has already happened
  • Managers are more confident handling performance, feedback and employee conversations because you've given them the tools and coaching to do it well
  • Our US People operations are organised, compliant and ready to scale as the team grows
  • You've simplified or improved the People processes that were creating unnecessary work for employees or managers
  • Employee relations and performance matters are handled consistently, confidently and with strong judgement
  • You've used People data and employee feedback to identify and deliver meaningful improvements to the US employee experience
  • You've helped strengthen the connection between our US team and the wider global Hapana culture

LIFE AT HAPANA

Summer Fridays — Fridays wrap at 3pm through summer, so your weekend gets a head start.

Birthday leave — take the day off on your birthday.

Wellness days — two extra days a year, separate from your annual leave, for whenever you need to reset.

Work from anywhere — two weeks a year to work from wherever you want. Visit family, chase the sun, change your view.

Home office stipend — money toward a setup you actually enjoy working from.

Parental leave — for primary and secondary carers, because every family looks different.

Health, dental and vision insurance — comprehensive coverage to help look after you and your health.

401(k) — a retirement savings plan to help you invest in your future.

EAP — confidential support and resources for you and your family when you need a little extra help.

JOIN US

We're building the technology powering the future of fitness, and we're only just getting started.

If you're an ambitious sales professional who loves building relationships, solving meaningful business problems and closing deals—and you want the opportunity to make a genuine impact in a growing global SaaS company—we'd love to hear from you.

Hapana is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. Different perspectives make us stronger, and they're one of the reasons we've come this far—and will continue to grow.

We're excited to manage this recruitment ourselves, so we won't be partnering with recruitment agencies for this opportunity.

Job Title:

Senior Substation Physical Engineer

Location:

Remote (U.S. based)

FLSA Classification

Exempt

Job Description:

Orbital is seeking a Senior SubstationPhysicalEngineer to provide technical support and direction for our Substation Design Team. This REMOTE WORK position which requires demonstrated leadership. engineering and design competency, in a utility or consulting environment for Electric Substation Projects with voltages up to 500 kV. The position requires excellent communication, leadership and client relation skills.

Responsible for technical leadership and oversight of substation engineering and consulting services for clients across the US. Primary responsibilities include creating electrical protection & control and/or physical design deliverables. Projects range in size, complexity, and voltage class from small equipment upgrades to large projects in transmission and distribution substations. The candidate may prepare, provide guidance, or assist in preparing and developing the engineering deliverables for electric substation projects. This position provides leadership and mentorship to other team members and contributes to the technical development of the group as well as the quality of our deliverables. May serve as project lead or independent reviewer for projects assigned.

Essential Functions

  • Utilizes understanding of the NEC, NESC, NEMA, ANSI, IEEE, industry standard work practices, client standards, and/or other applicable guidelines to complete engineering designs.
  • Act as project lead or independent reviewer for projects assigned.
  • Provide technical support for clients and support regional business development initiatives as a technical resource under the direction of the Department Manager.
  • Lead and mentor teams of engineers and designers and assume responsibility for their success on projects.
  • Support creation of proposals and scope development.
  • Work in a project team environment with other engineers and designers involved in detailed electrical design and project management of utility substation projects.
  • Participate in project conceptualization, work planning, and project execution.
  • Lead in the execution of engineering activities.
  • Physical substation design including equipment layouts, plans, sections, details, grounding, lightning protection, control building arrangements, cable routing, AC/DC power systems, and bills of material.
  • Calculations for studies and reports and preparation of equipment and installation specifications.
  • Coordination of design activities with other disciplines and groups.
  • Develop and improve processes, tools and technology within the organization.
  • Provide leadership, training and mentoring to other engineers and team members.
  • Regularly meet and correspond with clients or external partners.
  • Perform quality reviews for other engineers and designers.
  • Conduct field visits for site walkdowns, constructability reviews, construction support, and other site meetings as needed.
  • Support business development and marketing initiatives.
  • Other assignments may include relay setting development, 3D modeling/design, or industry/professional technical committee involvement.
  • Work with Project Management team to develop project plans and provide project updates.

Other Duties

Please note that this job posting does not list all duties and responsibilities that are required of this job. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from accredited college or university, or a related field with equivalent experience.
  • Position to be filled at an appropriate level according to candidate experience (Master’s degree may be considered as portion of total experience).
    • Senior Engineer I 7+ years related experience
    • Senior Engineer II 10+ years related experience
    • Senior Engineer III 15+ years related experience & PE Required
  • Professional Engineer registration strongly preferred
  • Proficiency with NESC, IEEE, and other relevant codes and standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively organize multiple complex assignments and competing priorities to produce accurate products on time.
  • Ability to collaborate in cross-functional work teams.
  • The successful candidate must have exceptional analytical and decision-making skills, and a successful record of positive interactions with clients.
  • Ability to lead staff, delegate assignments and drive positive results.
  • Experience in creating and reviewing substation design drawings.
  • Proficient with current software applications used to perform substation design work.
  • Ability to successfully work with remotely located team members.
  • This position requires the ability to pass a post-offer drug (including marijuana) and alcohol test in compliance with Federal regulations and is also subject to random testing as a condition of continued employment.

Location Note:

This is a remote or hybrid position. Compensation is based on market data and internal equity and may vary depending on the candidate’s location.

Salary Range:

$97,000-192,000 annually (based on experience, qualifications, and location)

Benefits:

A commitment to excellence and hard work will be rewarded with a competitive salary, career advancement opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; a 401(k)-retirement savings plan; and supplemental insurance options. We also provide company-paid life and AD&D insurance, company-paid short-term disability coverage, company-paid maternity and bonding leave, and a generous paid time off program to ensure you have the support and flexibility you need both professionally and personally.

About Orbital:Powered by People, Driven by Solutions

Since 1969, Orbital has been specializing in project development, project execution and asset management for the heavy industrial sectors and utilities. Our regional offices, hands-on mentality, and world-wide integrated teams provide an ability to leverage subject matter experts and industry best-practices wherever a project may lie geographically. Our focus steadfastly remains on finding and delivering the best solution, regardless of where that team sits across our organization. At Orbital, our power is our people.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

raw.description:
Description

You'll work with some of the largest and most complex construction risks in the country, delivering primary casualty coverage (workers' compensation, general liability, auto) for annual practice and wrap-up programs. This role focuses on our Large Construction portfolio, which serves many of the largest contractors in the US, backed by more than 100 years of construction underwriting experience and deep OCIP and CCIP program expertise.

You'll partner with the leadership team, bring deep technical expertise to the table, and serve as the go-to point of contact for frontline underwriting teams on questions, key decisions, and referrals. You'll also help shape and carry out portfolio strategies that keep performance strong and moving in the right direction.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert technical underwriting guidance and formal referral approval across multiple lines of business (auto, general liability, workers' compensation, and lead/excess) in Large Construction. Work independently with field underwriters and directly with underwriting managers on mandatory referrals and voluntary consultations.
  • Keep primary casualty and excess placements aligned and consistent, including across owner-controlled and contractor-controlled wrap-up programs (OCIP/CCIP) where the entire job site is covered under one consolidated program. Support leadership on transactions and act as a trusted advisor on exposure, coverage analysis, and key pricing and financial decisions within your authority.
  • Monitor the frameworks that guide underwriting decisions, such as referrals and technical reviews, and recommend improvements. Regularly evaluate portfolio performance in Large Construction, working with underwriting leaders to spot what's driving results, risks, and opportunities.
  • Drive underwriting technical excellence across Large Construction, partnering with underwriting leaders to identify and resolve issues.
  • Work with underwriting leaders to spot opportunities for product and service improvements and underwriter development, such as new skills or tools, and coordinate the resources to make them happen.
  • Model strong collaboration across teams, stakeholders, and partners, including underwriting support, claims, actuarial, and NA product teams.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key brokers and reinsurance/facultative partners. Join customer meetings, stewardship discussions, and new business presentations as needed.

Qualifications
  • Expert-level knowledge of all aspects of coverage forms, exclusions, and exposure.
